desc: Communicating with customers and prospects with the intent of creating sales opportunities. Reach out to existing and prospective customers through alternate media and networking channels, apart from cold calling/emailing.
notes: Lead / opportunity management - depends on the HubSpot-Halo integration.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Perform pre-sales activities
desc: Capitalizing on sales calls by pitching on bids and closing deals. Outline the nature and scope of the work, draft agreement terms, prepare proposals and agreements, and propose timelines and prices.
notes: Lead / opportunity management - depends on the HubSpot-Halo integration.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage customer meetings/workshops
desc: Arranging and leading meetings, seminars, workshops and training events with customers to educate them about current offerings, best practices and technological advances to provide more value to customers and to increase their attrition and loyalty.
notes: Lead / opportunity management - depends on the HubSpot-Halo integration.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Close the sale
desc: Formalizing a sale by reaching an agreement on terms of the deal. Negotiate on the price, and reach a consensus on the terms and conditions.
notes: Lead / opportunity management - depends on the HubSpot-Halo integration.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Record outcome of sales process
desc: Completing all the paper-work associated with the sale of its products/services. Exchange any pertinent legal/financial information required for completing the sale, signing of a contract/work-order, and issuing copies of bills/invoices.
notes: Lead / opportunity management - depends on the HubSpot-Halo integration.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage customers and accounts
desc: Managing the customer's expectations, with the intent of responsibly increasing the sale of the organization's products/services. Create a systematic method for governing sales, using sales forecasts and customer management measures. Develop a blueprint to manage relationships with customers and the data it holds on them, as well as the sale of its products/services to these customers. Devise a recipe for handling the organization's key customers in order to manage their expectations with tact and responsibility while maximizing revenue.
notes: Deferred: account planning sits with the XO / Account Management design. Customer master data: Halo owns customers; HubSpot owns marketing, leads and qualification.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Select key customers/accounts
desc: Choosing principal clients that are vital for the company.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Develop sales/key account plan
desc: Creating a plan for managing the accounts of key customers in order to better maintain relationships with them. Chart a scheme for managing sales. Create a plan for administering accounts of the significant and most important customers of the organization. Coordinate the accounts of principal clients.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage sales/key account plan
desc: Handling the accounts of important clients.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage customer relationships
desc: Managing the organization's relationship with its customers, by systematically coordinating interactions over multiple touch points, on a regular basis. Coordinate the organization's efforts to reach out to its customers. Create and manage effective touch points for interactions from the customers, which could include emails, social-media interactions, newsletters, and direct conversations.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage customer master data
desc: Managing the corpus of data relating all customers acquired over time. Manage the storage, maintenance, access, revision, and usage of all data on customers. Ensure its security, and determine legitimate use cases that are beneficial to the organization.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Collect and merge internal and third-party customer information
desc: Gathering the data about customers. Combine the information available locally with the data obtained from external sources.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: De-duplicate customer data
desc: Eliminating redundant information in customer data.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Develop and manage sales proposals, bids, and quotes
desc: Understanding and refining the customer requirements as provided in a RFP (Request for Proposal) or RFI (Request for Information).  When compiling the response, they must take into consideration whether the requirements are a match with the strategic or tactical plans of the organization and whether they are able to submit a bid/proposal that is competitive based on an understanding of the offerings of other competing organizations. The next step will be to define the pricing and scheduling of the proposed solution and determine whether the proposal will be profitable for the company if accepted. The bid is then submitted and a notification of whether or not it was successful is received.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Receive Request For Proposal (RFP)/Request For Quote (RFQ)
desc: Accepting procurement proposals.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Refine customer requirements
desc: Clarifying the details about procurement requests, such as the scope, timeline, data sources, type and characteristics and evaluation criteria for the goods or services to be delivered, and any additional terms, conditions or special requirements.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Review RFP/RFQ request
desc: Evaluating individual price and delivery solicitations for their strengths and weaknesses. Analyze how closely the submitted bids respond to the requirements outlined in the RFPs.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Perform competitive analysis
desc: Comparing the proposals submitted by different bidders in terms of cost, efficiency and value.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Validate with strategy/business plans
desc: Assessing the business strategy, forecasted performance, financing and cash flow of the proposals.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Understand customer business and requirements
desc: Deepening knowledge about the customer's field of operation and business needs.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Develop solution and delivery approach
desc: Creating a plan with detailed steps about how produce and deliver the goods or services.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Identify staffing requirements
desc: Determining the needs for internal resources and vacancies.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Develop pricing and scheduling estimates
desc: Establishing predicted delivery costs, fees and timelines.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Conduct profitability analysis
desc: Reviewing profitability data. Analyze systematically all relevant metrics and parameters. Report findings and make recommendations for changes to operational strategies.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage internal reviews
desc: Overseeing the internal review process.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage internal approvals
desc: Obtaining required company-internal authorizations.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Submit/present bid/proposal/quote to customer
desc: Delivering the proposal to the potential client.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Revise bid/proposal/quote
desc: Amending bids, proposals or quotes with more accurate time, cost or delivery estimates.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage notification outcome
desc: Handling proposals depending on whether they were accepted or rejected.
notes: Proposals, SOWs and quotes.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage sales orders
desc: Taking, receiving, processing, and acknowledging new customer orders or amendments to outstanding customer orders. Monitoring status from order receipt to customer delivery/customer invoicing.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Accept and validate sales orders
desc: Receiving and confirming orders from customers. Verify that no extra expenses have to be disbursed on part of the organization for labor or inventory when processing the order.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Collect and maintain account information
desc: Collecting and maintaining all account information. Collect information about the purchase, servicing, return, and/or commitment of any products/services on part of the organization to its customers. Bring together information from various organizational divisions, and update periodically.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Administer key account details
desc: Managing essential information of customer accounts.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Retrieve full customer details
desc: Obtaining detailed information about customers.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Modify involved party details
desc: Altering information about involved parties.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Record address details
desc: Documenting address information.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Record contact details
desc: Documenting contact information.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Record key customer communication profile details
desc: Providing information about important business rules regarding communicating with customers.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Review involved party information
desc: Revising information about involved parties.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Terminate involved party information
desc: Dismissing information about involved parties.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Determine availability
desc: Ascertaining the volume or scale of products/services to provide to customers to fulfill sales orders. Check the finished products stored in warehouses, the production capacity, and (in the case of services) the processing speed, as well as work force availability.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Determine fulfillment process
desc: Devising a blueprint for order fulfillment. Create a schematic flow encompassing all activities to deliver orders to the customers. Outline a procedure for satisfying these orders by answering questions about what needs to happen in sequence to realize an order.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Process back orders and updates
desc: Processing any unfulfilled orders, and updating the status of any orders that have been accepted and are being attended to. Deliver on any purchase orders that remain unserviced due to temporary unavailability of the product/service. Manage any updates to the sales orders. Revise their status in the order system.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Handle sales order inquiries including post-order fulfillment transactions
desc: Attending to any queries received from the customers, even after a sales order has been serviced. Deploy ad hoc personnel for managing these enquiries.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Provide product tracking
desc: Providing visibility into the status and progress of products associated with customer orders to support order fulfillment, customer communication, and issue resolution.
notes: Closed-won handoff into contracts and billing.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage sales partners and alliances
desc: Managing the organization's partners and alliances, with the objective of maximizing revenue. Train partners regarding the organization's portfolio of products/services. Craft sales forecasts. Examine their performance. Manage all data held by the organization on these partners.
notes: Deferred: alliance and channel partners (Microsoft, Pax8, Red River-style subcontracts).

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Provide sales and product/service training to sales partners/alliances
desc: Imparting guidance and instruction to sales partners/alliances concerning products/services. Distribute literature about the organization's products/services. Conduct workshops. Disseminate useful media content to engage and enlighten partners. Create communities through group engagements.
notes: Microsoft, Cisco and Red River style partner / subcontract motions.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Provide certification enablement training
desc: Provide training and certification to develop strategies for marketing-driven sales.
notes: Microsoft, Cisco and Red River style partner / subcontract motions.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage certifications and skills
desc: Reviewing, processing and issuing certifications and accrediting skills and competencies.
notes: Microsoft, Cisco and Red River style partner / subcontract motions.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Provide support to partners/alliances
desc: Backing sales partners and strategic alliances.
notes: Microsoft, Cisco and Red River style partner / subcontract motions.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Provide marketing materials to sales partners/alliances
desc: Distributing marketing materials and sales brochures to entities that the company partners with.
notes: Microsoft, Cisco and Red River style partner / subcontract motions.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Evaluate partner/alliance results
desc: Examining the performance of its partners/alliances in selling its products/services. Use metrics such as growth in revenue generated, conversion rate, and total outreach to customers for assessing the performance results.
notes: Microsoft, Cisco and Red River style partner / subcontract motions.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Manage sales partner/alliance master data
desc: Managing the repository of data relating to the organization's partners/alliances over time. Store, maintain, access, revise, and use all data on partners/alliances. Manage data. Ensure its security. Determine legitimate use cases that are beneficial to the organization.
notes: Microsoft, Cisco and Red River style partner / subcontract motions.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Perform sales at physical outlets
desc: Execution of sales at physical / brick and mortar locations.
notes: No physical retail outlets.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Perform field sales
desc: Execution of sales within field/remote locations.  This could be any location that is not part of a headquarters location.

cat: Market and Sell Products and Services
name: Perform digital sales
desc: Execution of sales in an online environment.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
desc: Performing supply chain activities include planning supply chain, procuring materials and services, and managing logistics.
notes: Physical-product supply chain. Only procurement (4.2) applies - hardware and licensing resale.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Plan for and align supply chain resources
desc: Creating strategies for production and materials. Handle the demand for the products of the organization. Develop plans for handling materials. Develop and administer the schedule for master production. Plan for distribution requirements and its constraints by reviewing and assessing distribution policies and performance and by establishing quality standards and procedures.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop production and materials strategies
desc: Creating strategies for production processes, as well as the process of managing materials. Define production and supply constraints. Design a blueprint of the workplace. Establish rules and regulations regarding the employees, outsourcing of services, and the expenditure to be incurred on the manufacturing capital.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define manufacturing goals
desc: Creating quantifiable strategic objectives for each manufacturing segment in conjunction with sales projections.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define labor and materials policies
desc: Setting up internal rules and regulations regarding the employees and the materials.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define outsourcing policies
desc: Creating rules and regulations regarding contracting out of a business process to another party in order to reduce costs.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define capital expense policies
desc: Designing rules and regulations pertaining to the expenditure incurred in acquiring or upgrading the existing stock of manufacturing capital.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define capacities
desc: Outlining the manufacturing and processing capacities of the organization. Delineate the capabilities required for optimizing output with available resources. Analyze capabilities possessed by the organization concerning the raw materials required and the process necessitated for producing finished products.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define production network and supply constraints
desc: Defining limitations in the ability of the organization's supply chain to deliver a new stock, and creating a network of production stakeholders. Frame and manage relationships within the flow of manufacturing and processing operations. Identify probable supply issues.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define production process
desc: Outlining the scheme of processing inventory into finished products/services. This includes the use of raw materials, machinery, skill sets, and knowledge to create new offerings.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define standard operating procedures
desc: Establishing or prescribing methods to be followed routinely for the performance of designated operations or in designated situations. This may include step-by-step instructions to help workers carry out complex routine operations. The goal is to improve efficiency, quality, and uniformity of performance, while reducing miscommunication, failure, or rework.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define production workplace layout and infrastructure
desc: Determining the floor plans for the processing facility that is meant for delivering finished products/services. Identify the totality of infrastructure needed for using this space in the manufacturing process, including machinery, factory floors, offices, and furniture.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage demand for products
desc: Forecasting demand for products using secondary research and customer feedback. Refine these forecasts. Inspect the approach used in creating forecasts, and determine its accuracy.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop baseline demand forecasts
desc: Identify the bedrock levels of market demand anticipated for the organization's products/services. Estimate future demand for product and services using historical data, analysis of the market environment and any externalities, etc. to create ex ante approximations. This includes operation planning.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Collaborate demand with customers
desc: Working closely with the organization's customers to understand their drives and behavior, with the objective of estimating future demand. Reach out to customers through various means to understand their behavior patterns, usage elasticity, and degree of variability--and ultimately determine demand for each offering.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop demand consensus forecast
desc: Arriving at a consensus over the forecasted levels of demand for products/services. Consensus is achieved by juxtaposing decisions developed in the baseline forecast with those reached at by collaborating with customers. Enlist senior-level decision makers of the sales and marketing functions.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Determine available to promise
desc: Identify the volume of products/services that may be committed for delivery to fulfill sales. Figure out the amount of stock available. Forecast its volumes.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Monitor activity against demand forecast and revise forecast
desc: Picking out any activity that deviates from the forecast, and adjusting it. Closely track and study the levels of demand as they emerge. Refine the consensus forecast as needed.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Evaluate and revise demand forecasting approach
desc: Examining the methodology used to estimate future demand. Refine it in light of current market realities and demand.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Measure demand forecast accuracy
desc: Calculating and inspecting the accuracy of demand forecasts. Use metrics to check the reliability of the forecasts created.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create materials plan
desc: Developing a scheme that allows for advance planning for the availability of raw materials and spares. Start with an unconstrained plan, and refine based on supply chain realities by identifying critical materials required for production, checking material specifications, and collaborating with all vendors over the supply.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create unconstrained plan
desc: Developing a plan for raw materials and other inventory items in order to meet market demand. Ensure the availability of all inventory items such as raw materials and spares. Create a blueprint in line with Define labor and materials policies [10230].

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Collaborate with supplier and contract manufacturers
desc: Collaborating with vendors and contractual manufacturers with the objective of ensuring a continual supply of raw materials and spares. Leverage long-term connections/relationships with various suppliers, and cultivate new ones. Track the activities of all vendors. Receive regular updates to prepare for any fluctuations in supply.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Identify critical materials and supplier capacity
desc: Identifying principal materials needed for the manufacturing process and the levels of supply that may be ensured for them. Determine the essential and crucial inventory items required for the smooth functioning of all manufacturing processes. Estimate the average, peak, and baseline capacities of various vendors and suppliers. Establish the capability of individual suppliers from the market and the vendors.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Monitor material specifications
desc: Observing and surveying all inventory items in order to check for the veracity of their specifications. Monitor various attributes and characteristics for respective inventory items such as density, volume, and size, as well as contextualized specifications particular to the respective materials.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Generate constrained plan
desc: Generating a bounded plan that takes stock of the actual supply chain scenario. Take stock of all information collected while creating an inventory supply plan.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define production balance and control
desc: Defining an equitable volume for the production of products/services that adheres to an equilibrium value, and creating a scheme of control for processing items. Create schematics for systematically planning, coordinating, and directing the manufacturing activities in line with the production balance determined.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create and manage master production schedule
desc: Taking care of the master production plan. The master production includes creation and implementation of the site-level production plan, as well as management of the inventory that is currently in the production process.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Model production network to enable simulation and optimization
desc: Create representative logical system that provides the framework to attain strategic objectives based on resources, product volumes, and processes. Provides the general sequential flow and capacity requirement relationships among raw materials, parts, resources, finished products, and product families.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create master production schedule
desc: Creating  the plan for internal activities such as production, inventory, and staffing. Include forecasted quantity of items to produce based on inputs from sales planning, demand planning/forecasting, and supply chain partners.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Maintain master production schedule
desc: Supervising and overseeing the plan for internal activities such as production, inventory, and staffing. Set the quantity of items to produce each week of a short-range planning horizon.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Plan distribution requirements
desc: Maintaining master data of finished products and inventory. Identify the requirements of finished products at the destination, as well as partner requirements. Calculate the consolidation at source. Manage replenishment planning. Create and administer a dispatch plan. Calculate load plans for destinations and partners. Manage the cost of supplying these products. Ensure effective utilization of capacity.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Maintain master data
desc: Maintaining and preserving the master data plan for distribution requirements. Create a systematic collection of facts and figures regarding the distribution of the inventories. Maintain policies, processes, and tools covering the distribution function.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Determine finished goods inventory requirements at destination
desc: Interact with the concerned person at the destination to validate the requirements and to avoid any miscommunication of information.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Determine product storage facility requirements
desc: Evaluate constraints, needs, parameters, and conditions for physical storage and retrieval of components or products for future use or shipment in a storage facility within a certain timeframe.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Calculate requirements at destination
desc: Interact with the concerned authority at the destination to reach a specific figure that correctly represents requirements.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Calculate consolidation at source
desc: Determining the aggregate volume of products/services consolidated at the source. Calculate the number of finished products that are ready to be delivered to the customers, particularly at one date.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage collaborative replenishment planning
desc: Administering the plan for collaborative replenishment of goods. Replenish inventory by creating a plan in case of faulty production.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Calculate and optimize destination dispatch plan
desc: Estimating the timing and duration of the delivery of the inventory from the source to the destination. Plan the logistic details of all the distribution routes and activities.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage dispatch plan attainment
desc: Accomplishing the dispatch plan. Strictly follow the schedule, and adjust for deviations. Coordinate with the concerned authorities at various destinations.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Calculate and optimize destination load plans
desc: Evaluating the plans for delivering loads to destinations. Create a systematic plan that specifies the load plans for every single destination.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage partner load plan
desc: Administering the load plan for partners. Manage the delivery, and dispatch from the source to the partners.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage cost of supply
desc: Managing all expenses to provide products/services in the market. Estimate the overall cost of supplying of products/inventory, including the cost distributing it through various partners and channels. Consider the cost of all the logistical processes that occur from the moment a product is ready to be dispatched to the time it reaches the destination.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage capacity utilization
desc: Determining the capacity utilization of the organization's production process. Realize the extent to which an enterprise uses its installed productive capacity (i.e., the relationship between output and the potential output if capacity was fully used).

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish distribution planning constraints
desc: Instituting the constraints for planning of distribution process. Create a plan that specifies every element in the distribution process from the blueprint of the distribution centers to how and when the inventory would reach the distribution centers.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish distribution center layout constraints
desc: Instituting the constraints for creating a layout for distribution center. Consider factors such as the number of customers, demand forecasting, product groups, condition of product conservation, warehousing, and transportation management.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish inventory management constraints
desc: Determining any problems that might be faced while managing inventory. Identify problems and possible issues in managing the warehousing of the raw materials, spares, and other items of inventory. Take stock of inventory needs, and determine the exact quantity of the inventory needed in the near future.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish transportation management constraints
desc: Identifying any potential constraints while deciding on the dispatch and delivery plan from the source to the various distribution centers. Decide how the inventory will be transported , which and how many transportation means to use, what route to take, etc.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish storage management constraints
desc: Determining potential constraints for physical storage and retrieval of components or products in a storage facility within a certain timeframe. Consider factors such as the building shape, height, capacity, door locations, lift equipment, automation, etc.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Review distribution planning policies
desc: Revisiting and refurbishing the policies for planning the distribution process. Asses the distribution strategies, including how the products are to be made available and sent to different distributors. Set guidelines regarding relationships between the sources and the distribution centers.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Review distribution network
desc: Evaluating the system that defines how the products/inventory would reach from the source (i.e., manufacturer) to the destination (i.e., retailer/distributer).

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish sourcing relationships
desc: Establishing relationships with transportation/distribution sources in order to ensure an effective distribution network and strategy. Screen and evaluate various sources available to pick out the best among them.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish dynamic deployment policies
desc: Creating strategic guidelines on the availability of the products at all the distribution centers. Create a dynamic network to ensure availability at all times, even in cases of defaults.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop quality standards and procedures
desc: Developing standards and procedures for maintaining the quality of products/services. Establish desired quality targets. Create standardized procedures for the quality. Ensure quality specifications are effectively communicated.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish quality targets
desc: Defining specific qualitative and quantitative target figures.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop standard testing procedures
desc: Creating standard procedures for testing the quality of products/services. Describe the steps of key processes to help ensure consistent and quality output. Define the routine instructions for performing the quality testing activity.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Communicate quality specifications
desc: Communicating the desired quality specifications to the manufacturing units, as well as the distribution centers, to avoid any misunderstanding or misinterpretation.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Procure materials and services
desc: Creating a plan for procuring materials and services. Develop strategies for sourcing materials and services. Choose the most appropriate suppliers, and develop contracts with them. Order the materials and services as per the requirements. Manage relationships with suppliers.
notes: Hardware and license procurement / vendor management.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Provide sourcing governance
desc: Creating strategies for procuring materials and services from various sources, and for managing and evaluating categories. Establish a procurement process that describes the approach for obtaining products and purchasing activities. Evaluate the sources. Create sourcing relationships in order to continuously improve. Re-evaluate purchasing activities.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop procurement plan
desc: Creating a plan for procuring materials and services. Plan what to buy, when, and from what sources. Include project requirements, the procurement team, the justification for the procurement, a timeline of events, and an explanation of the supplier selection process. Outline specific actions to start and complete purchases in order to adhere to best practices.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Clarify purchasing requirements
desc: Defining the purchasing requirements for materials and services. Specify the exact inventory required for the production process. Create a specific quotation for all the sources in order to avoid any duplication or overlap.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Establish materials management contingency plans
desc: Developing a strategy to deal with issues projected to arise during implementation of the inventory plan. Identify how to react to issues that arise and require changes to the inventory plan, such as a vendor failing to deliver materials on time. Collaborate with production and suppliers to prepare solutions to projected problems.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Match needs to supply capabilities
desc: Synchronizing the requirements of materials and services and the capacity of suppliers for providing these materials and services. Revamp the procurement needs of the company in consideration of the capabilities of the suppliers.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Analyze organization’s spend profile
desc: Evaluating the spend profile of the organization. Collect, cleanse, classify, and analyze the procurement data with the purpose of reducing procurement costs, improving efficiency, and monitoring compliance.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Seek opportunities to improve efficiency and value
desc: Seeking the most efficient sourcing and procurement opportunities.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Collaborate with suppliers to align with long term business goals
desc: Collaborating with the suppliers of materials and services in order to determine new opportunities for sourcing, share market insights, manage risk, identify and align supplier capabilities with long-term business goals.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Collaborate with suppliers to identify sourcing opportunities
desc: Collaborating with the suppliers of materials and services in order to determine new opportunities for sourcing.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop category plan
desc: Defining sourcing strategies and plans for categories of materials or services to optimize cost, supply continuity, value, and alignment with organizational requirements and market conditions.
notes: Hardware and license procurement / vendor management.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Analyze category/product positioning and performance
desc: Analyzing the position and performance of sourcing categories or products based on spend, supplier dynamics, market conditions, and value contribution to inform category planning decisions.
notes: Hardware and license procurement / vendor management.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Forecast demand for each category by market
desc: Forecasting demand for sourcing categories across relevant markets or consumption channels to support planning, supplier strategy, and capacity alignment.
notes: Hardware and license procurement / vendor management.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Assign revenue and margin targets to each category
desc: Establishing revenue, cost, and margin targets for sourcing categories to guide category strategy, sourcing decisions, and performance evaluation.
notes: Hardware and license procurement / vendor management.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Select suppliers and develop/maintain contracts
desc: Evaluating supplier options to select the most effective and efficient suppliers. Validate selected suppliers. Establish and manage supplier contracts.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Select suppliers
desc: Evaluating the pros and cons of various suppliers. Choose the most appropriate and cost-effective suppliers on the basis of their material quality, delivery schedules, and costs.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Certify and validate suppliers
desc: Validating the supply sources, and provide certification as an official supplier.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Negotiate and establish contracts
desc: Legally binding suppliers with the company. Negotiate contracts individually with all the suppliers that include the promised material delivery, the delivery dates and duration, etc.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage contracts
desc: Keeping contracts up-to-date with routine evaluation. Maintain order and discipline with the contracts in order to avoid any loss of information and mishaps.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Assign vendor risk tiers
desc: Tier every vendor Critical, High, Medium or Low by its access to systems and data and how critical its service is; an untiered vendor is treated as Critical.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Perform tier-based vendor due diligence
desc: Critical and High: audit report (SOC 2 / ISO 27001), security questionnaire, breach history, financial condition, data types, fourth parties, IR/BC/DR documents, legal history. Medium: abbreviated review. No access before diligence is complete.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Include security and notification terms in vendor contracts
desc: Critical and High contracts cover SLAs, data protection, audit rights, breach notification, subcontractor responsibility, indemnification and continuity.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Order materials and services
desc: Creating and approving requisitions and distributing purchase orders accordingly. Hasten the procurement process to satisfy internal needs.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Process/Review requisitions
desc: Handling operations related to processing/reviewing the requisitions. Establish and maintain procedures for the initiation, authorization, and processing of purchase requirements to procure products/services.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Approve requisitions
desc: Approving requisitions for materials and services. Examine distributor-specific requests, and validate them individually.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Solicit supplier quotes
desc: Requesting quotes from suppliers. Use a request for quotation (RFQ) to invite suppliers into a bidding process for specific products/services.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create/Distribute purchase orders
desc: Creating and placing the orders for purchasing materials and services from suppliers. Analyze vendor quotes. Choose the most cost-effective vendors. Create vendor-specific orders. Distribute them in order to initiate the purchasing process.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Expedite orders and satisfy inquiries
desc: Accelerating the purchase orders in order to fulfill the internal needs (for raw materials) depicted through inquiries.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Reconcile purchase orders
desc: Verify that purchase orders are filled as expected: verify that items and quantities are delivered as expected, based on purchase order details and goods receipts.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Research/Resolve order exceptions
desc: Identifying and resolving any exceptions. Address the internal needs/inquiries for materials that cannot be procured immediately. Research inquiries that require the need of exceptional materials.
notes: Includes drop-ship hardware and Microsoft CSP license orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage suppliers
desc: Collecting and analyzing new information in order to track and rate suppliers and build relationships.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Monitor/Manage supplier information
desc: Create and maintain vendor master files. Examining procurement and vendor performance. Report delivery timing and the quality of the materials procured through different vendors.  This data must align with vendor master file, see PCFID 10869.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Prepare/Analyze procurement and supplier performance
desc: Assisting the production and inventory processes through the information and reports created. Use the information and metrics of the procurement and vendor performance to enhance or improve the production process.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Support inventory and production processes
desc: Support inventory and production processes by analyzing impact of procurement decisions and collaborating to constantly improve. (For example, perhaps minimum order requirements could be negotiated to be lower, to reduce excessive inventory and make production more flexible.)

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Monitor quality of product delivered
desc: Track the performance of the suppliers on product quality. Use this information to further improve sourcing and supplier performance.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Maintain the vendor inventory
desc: Every vendor carries a risk tier, a named internal owner and a last-assessed date.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Reassess vendors by tier
desc: Critical and High at least annually or at renewal; Medium every two years or on scope change; includes fourth-party dependencies and monitoring for incidents, financial or ownership change.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Maintain vendor SLAs, escalation contacts and exit strategies
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: For mission-critical and business-critical platforms: SLAs, support tiers, escalation contacts and status pages verified annually, with a documented exit strategy (export format, migration path, alternate vendor).

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Offboard vendors
desc: Revoke and verify removal of all vendor access; obtain return or documented destruction of data; retain the completion record.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Approve and track vendor policy exceptions
desc: Document the exception, accept residual risk at the right level, set a review date, and review exceptions annually.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Produce/Assemble/Test product
desc: Processing and delivering the finished goods manufactured by the organization. Schedule the production of products. Execute the product production activities. Perform tests to oversee and ensure quality of production. Maintain records of the production process. Track lots.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Schedule production
desc: Scheduling the production of final products. Generate a detailed schedule plan. Create and release production orders and lots. Schedule the planned and unplanned maintenance orders.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Model and simulate plant
desc: Creating a representation of plant facilities to optimize material flow, resource utilization, and logistics for all levels of plant planning from global production facilities, through local plants, to specific lines and enabling the comparison of production alternatives,.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Generate line level plan
desc: Initiating the line-level plan for production. Break down the production schedule into specific lines, specifying the various objectives the production schedule.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Generate detailed schedule
desc: Broadening the line-level plan. Specify all the individual production processes, along with the timing and the duration to come up with a working schedule that tracks the whole process and any deviations that might occur.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Schedule production orders and create lots
desc: Creating a schedule to commence production of orders received, and creating lots to consolidate the processing. Plan when the production orders are to be initiated by commencing the operations for processing products/services. Specify which materials to produce, where to produce them, which operations will facilitate this, and on which date production is to start. Define the size of production lots, demarcating the durations of batch production.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Plan for preventive maintenance
desc: Scheduling planned maintenance of the production equipment.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Request unplanned maintenance
desc: Scheduling requested maintenance in order to address breakdowns where repairs or corrective remedies are needed immediately. Create a scheme for undertaking unplanned maintenance work on equipment/machinery that has come to be in urgent need for it. Express turnaround to redress using specialized personnel.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Release production orders and create lots
desc: Initiating the delivery of production orders, and creating lots. Communicate the order that specifies which material to produce, where to produce it, which operations to require, and on which date production takes place. Define how to settle the order costs. Create production lots, which is a particular production unit of an assembly that is planned and manufactured.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Produce/Assemble product
desc: Manufacturing the product. Convert the raw materials to develop consumer-ready products. Manage the raw materials to implement the detailed production schedule. Reproduce defectives to establish and remediate cause. Ensure production optimization and benchmark performance.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage raw material inventory
desc: Administering the inventory of raw materials. Manage the total cost of all component parts in stock but not yet used. Manage the cost of the direct materials (i.e., materials incorporated into the final product) and indirect materials (i.e., materials not incorporated into the final product but consumed during the production process).

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Execute detailed line schedule
desc: Creating and implementing the detailed line production schedule on the ground level.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Report maintenance issues
desc: Recording and reporting any deviations or issues in the maintenance schedule, in the performance to the production management team, and for unplanned maintenance.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Rerun defective items
desc: Reproducing the items produced defectively. Assess the produced items by conducting quality and standardization tests in order to diagnose any discrepancies. Reproduce defective items.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Monitor and optimize production process
desc: Integrating different resources in the production process: material, personnel, equipment, robotics, etc. Includes automating and controlling the plant, performing advanced process control and real-time optimization. This activity also includes managing plant alarms and alerts.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Automate and control plant
desc: Creating and applying technology to monitor and control the production and delivery of products and services. Automation involves a broad range of technologies.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Perform advanced process control
desc: Including a broad range of techniques and technologies implemented within industrial process control systems that are routinely reviewed, audited, and improved, advanced process controls typically address particular performance or economic improvement opportunities. An advanced set of process control measures can be used to reduce variation and identify primary improvement options. Results of analysis are fed back into process design for incorporation into production.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Perform real-time optimization
desc: Helping organizations increase performance and efficiency, real-time optimization is a category of closed-loop process control that aims at optimizing process performance in real time for systems. It is normally built upon model-based optimization systems and is usually large scale. Real-time optimization automatically detects errors, and can modify and eliminate both random and non-random errors, as well as analyze and monitor all systems involved.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage plant alarms and alerts
desc: Applying human factors and instrumentation engineering and systems thinking to manage the design of an alarm or alert system to increase its usability. Typical challenges include having too many alarms in a plant, poorly designed alarms/alerts, improperly set alarm/alert points, unclear alarm/alert messages, etc. Poor alarm management is one of the leading causes of unplanned downtime.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Assess production performance
desc: Analyzing and benchmarking the production process to judge its effectiveness and efficiency. Create production metrics to numerically calculate the performance of the production process.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Perform quality testing
desc: Executing tests to evaluate the quality of the products manufactured. Calibrate the test equipment. Conduct the actual tests. Record the results and outcomes of the quality test conducted.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Calibrate test equipment
desc: Regulating the equipment used for performing quality tests. Assess correspondence between the quality testing equipment and the desired quality standards. Ensure the calibration standard is more accurate than the instrument being tested.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Perform testing using the standard testing procedure
desc: Performing testing using calibrated equipment and in consent with the standard testing procedure, including testing time.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage quality samples
desc: Selecting a set of elements from a product lot to draw conclusions or make inferences about the quality of the product lot from which the sample is drawn. Sampling is frequently used because gathering data on every product produced by a company is often impossible, impractical, or too costly to collect.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Record test results
desc: Documenting the results and outcomes of the quality tests. Track the performance of the production process. Record/Document it to evaluate the qualitative efficiency of the production process. Use electronic devices and software in order to ensure effectiveness in recording the results and outcomes of the test.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Track and analyze non-conformance trends
desc: Managing and monitoring the occurrences of problems with a process or product. It is important that nonconformance occurrences are tracked in a standardized way so the data can easily be reviewed to assess the impact of the problem. Ongoing analysis of trends in nonconformance gives an organization the ability to make process changes to reduce the incidence and cost of nonconformances.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Perform root cause analysis
desc: Using a technique that helps people answer the question of why a problem occurred in the first place. It seeks to identify the origin of a problem using a specific set of steps, with associated tools, to find the primary cause of the problem to determine what happened, why, and how to reduce the likelihood that it will happen again.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Maintain production records and manage lot traceability
desc: Perpetuating the production records by systematically documenting and using it to ensure the effective management of lots. Determine the lot numbering system and its use. (The lot number enables tracking of the constituent parts, as well as labor and equipment records involved in the manufacturing of a product. It enables manufacturers and to perform quality control checks, calculate expiration dates, and issue corrections of their production output.)

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Determine lot numbering system
desc: Allotting an identification number to a particular quantity or lot of material manufactured. Assign lot numbers on the basis of specific production units, material similarity, etc. Place lot numbers on the outside of packaging.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Determine lot use
desc: Identifying the use of production lots. Define where, how, and when to use a specific production lot.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage logistics and warehousing
desc: Administering and overseeing all activities related to logistics and warehousing. Outline and establish a strategy for the logistics function. Plan and administer the flow of inbound materials. Administer the operational activities of warehousing and outbound transportation. Manage reverse logistics including returns and exchanges.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Provide logistics governance
desc: Outlining the strategy for managing logistics. Translate customer requirements logistic requirements. Create an efficient logistic network and outsourcing portions of logistics activities. Design a logistics strategy that optimizes transportation costs and schedule. Define key performance indicators.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Translate customer service requirements into logistics requirements
desc: Determining the requirements for managing the flow of things between the point of origin and the point of consumption by assessing the service requirements of the customers.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Design logistics network
desc: Developing a network for logistical activities. Create a network of entities through which materials and information flow, encompassing all related activities associated with the flow of transformation of products.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Communicate outsourcing needs
desc: Conveying outsourcing needs within the organization, with the objective of sourcing the assistance required. Define the portion of logistical activities that can be transferred to outside suppliers. Assess third-party agencies to carefully select the most appropriate agencies for outsourcing. Convey these needs to management or the appropriate authority.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Develop and maintain delivery service policy
desc: Establishing rules and regulations, as well as the terms and conditions regarding the delivery of service by the company. Develop a delivery plan that specifies what, how, when, and in which way to deliver services to the customer.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Optimize transportation schedules and costs
desc: Optimizing the schedule and costs of transportation services. Design a logistics strategy by strategically creating delivery routes and systems, which optimizes the overall transportation schedules and costs. Evaluate different transportation sources in order to select the most appropriate and cost-effective sources.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define key performance measures
desc: Establishing measures for evaluating the performance of the logistics strategy of the organization. Establish key performance indicators, including the logistics performance index, delivery in full, and delivery on time.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Define reverse logistics strategy
desc: Establish a strategy that includes rules and regulations for the physical handling, information processing, and disposition of product and packaging returned by the buyer to the seller or an intermediary. Include return approval, transportation coordination, advance communication, product tracking, receipt, disposition of the return, and processing warranty claims in the strategy.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Plan and manage inbound material flow
desc: Creating and executing a strategy for all the internal activities related to the flow/transfer of inbound materials. This process includes planning inbound material receipts, managing inbound material flow, monitoring inbound delivery performance, managing the flow of returned products, controlling the quality of returned parts, and salvaging or repairing returned products.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Plan inbound material receipts
desc: Managing the receipts of inbound materials. Create a plan accounting for the materials procured from the source of supply and the materials delivered to the distribution center or the warehouse.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage inbound material flow
desc: Managing all the internal activities related to the flow/transfer of materials. Manage materials being delivered to distribution center or warehouse. Gauge the time taken for delivery and if the delivery process is on time.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Monitor inbound delivery performance
desc: Overseeing the performance of an inbound delivery system. Check the present delivery system's efficiency, cost effectiveness, and adherence to a delivery schedule.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage flow of returned products
desc: Tracking and taking care of the products that have been internally returned either because of their deficiency or in cases of incorrect delivery.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage disposition of returned products
desc: Determining if a returned product can be salvaged or repaired. Salvage or repair is dependent upon the product, the condition of the product, or the availability of a like item.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Determine quality of controlled part
desc: Implement a checks and balances system to verify that returned parts meet acceptable quality standards to determine appropriate disposition activity.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Perform salvage activities
desc: Executing activities for reinstating the returned products. Present the customer with additional incentives of compensation in case of any defective products delivery or any discrepancy in the product specifications in order to save the order from being permanently returned.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage repair/refurbishment
desc: Administering the reinstatement of the returned product in order to return them back to customers. Repair or remanufacture the defective or ineffective products returned by the customer. Process the delivery of the repaired or remanufactured products back to the customer.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Return to finished goods inventory
desc: Moving a returned product back to inventory or stock. Whether a product is sufficient as returned, repaired, or refurbished, moving that product back to inventory for resale or returning to customer is the fnal step in Manage disposition of returned products.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Operate warehousing
desc: Tracking the inventory deployment. Accept and store products. Ship the products. Measure the accuracy of the inventory. Assess the performance of the outsourced logistics activities.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage and track inventory deployment
desc: Tracking the logistical act of delivering or releasing an inventory item or entity to targeted end users. Track how much inventory has been deployed at all the distribution centers, individually.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Receive, inspect, and store inbound deliveries
desc: Coordinating the incoming inbound materials/products. Accept the delivery of these materials and the subsequent storage. Track them at the warehouse/distribution center.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Track product availability
desc: Keeping track of the availability of different materials/products at the warehouse and distribution centers.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Pick, pack, and ship product for delivery
desc: Packing and shipping the product to deliver to the customer. Take care of the internal and external packaging of the products in order to ensure safe transportation of the products from the warehouse to delivery locations. Notify the ERP system and/or Accounts Receivable Dept.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Track inventory accuracy
desc: Monitoring any discrepancies between electronic records that represent the inventory and the physical state of the inventory. Look for discrepancies such as phantom inventory, which includes products that an inventory accounting system considers to be available at the storage location but are not actually available.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Track third-party logistics storage and shipping performance
desc: Keeping a track on the storage and shipping performance of third-party agencies. Monitor logistics storage and shipping performance for third-party agencies. Use measures such as a logistics scoreboard, activity-based costing, economic value analysis, and balanced scorecards.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage physical finished goods inventory
desc: Administering the movement of the finished products that are processed by the organization through its warehouses. Track goods through the use of systems such as barcodes in order to monitor the volumes available, quantity of out-flowing goods, remaining shelf life of the product, etc.--ultimately, to best manage the warehouse capacity.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage warehouse transfers
desc: Shipping items from one warehouse to another in a multi-warehouse environment. A warehouse transfer is typically handled electronically in a system designed to replicate the physical processes involved with transferring items from one warehouse to another.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Operate outbound transportation
desc: Creating a plan that specifies the schedule and system for transportation and delivery of the outbound products, as well as tracking the performance of the carrier delivery system. Conduct vehicle management and processing of all carrier-related documents.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Plan, transport, and deliver outbound product
desc: Organizing the transportation and delivery of outbound products. Plan and organize the transportation, shipping, and delivery of the end products. Create a plan that specifies dispatch and delivery of the product to its destination, as well the transportation.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Track carrier delivery performance
desc: Monitoring delivery performance when carrying products from the warehouse/distribution centers to the retailers or end consumers. Create a performance metrics based on the key performance indicators.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage transportation fleet
desc: Taking care of a range of functions related to the means of transport used for delivering the end products. Manage vehicle financing, vehicle maintenance, vehicle telematics (tracking and diagnostics), driver management, speed management, fuel management, and health and safety management.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Process and audit carrier invoices and documents
desc: Organizing and inspecting all account statements and any other documentation for the carriers used in delivery. Create, manage, and inspect all documents related to the financial, regulatory, and administrative accounts of all the carriers/freights. Generate receipts for all freight transactions.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Deliver last mile delivery services
desc: Validating specific service requirements for individual customers. Determine and schedule resource to fulfill these requirements. Provide service to specific individual customers. Ensure the quality of service delivery.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Confirm specific last mile delivery service requirements for individual customer
desc: Acquiring or soliciting information about specific service requirements for individual customers through the customer service function. Obtain information about customer specific requests, process these requests, and create customer profiles to generate a service order.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Process customer request
desc: Soliciting or acquiring information using various sources such as databases, customer interactions, and customer request forms. Hand them further up the hierarchy to deal with them. Categorize the user's request, determining if the request is supportable and prioritizing the request.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create customer profile
desc: Documenting the individual customer service requirements solicited, along with personal information of the customers, in order to generate customized profiles that hasten the delivery process.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Generate last mile delivery order
desc: Designing a short-term agreement between the service provider and customer. One-time services are ordered by the service recipient and resource-related billing is performed upon completion. Use the service order to document service and customer service work.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Identify and schedule resources to meet last mile delivery requirements
desc: Determining and scheduling the resources required to fulfill customer service requirements. Create a detailed schedule about the service orders and development of these service orders.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create resourcing plan and schedule
desc: Developing a plan for sourcing and deploying the resources required to fulfill customer service needs. Document a detailed summary of all types of resources (equipment, finance, personnel, time, etc.) required to complete customer service requests and procure these resources. Identify and assess various sources in order to effectively create a resourcing plan.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Create last mile delivery service order fulfillment schedule
desc: Designing a detailed summary of customer service order requirements, along with information concerning the timing and duration for these services. Categorize the customer needs. Monitor the services delivered.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Provide last mile delivery service to specific customers
desc: Dispatching resources for managing and fulfilling daily service requirements. Manage the progress of order fulfillment. Complete order blocks.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Organize daily last mile delivery order fulfillment schedule
desc: Laying out a daily plan of specific service orders that need to be fulfilled. Document and systematically order these activities to ensure high effectiveness and efficiency.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Execute product delivery
desc: Dispatching and delivering the resources needed for the specific service requirements from the source/warehouse. Manage the dispatch, transportation, and delivery of the services.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Manage last mile delivery order fulfillment
desc: Handling and managing orders fulfilled, along with the orders are not or partially fulfilled to track the order fulfillment progress. Use electronic devices such as trackers and GPS in order track and ensure delivery of the orders.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Ensure quality of last mile delivery
desc: Guaranteeing the quality of service provided to customers. Identify the successful and unsuccessful orders along with the service failures. Collect customer feedback. Process the feedback to ensure the quality of service in the future.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Identify completed last mile delivery orders for feedback
desc: Determining the service orders that have been successfully delivered. Identify the service orders completed and delivered to the customer. Leverage communication systems to ensure coordination with the customers in order to avoid mishaps.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Identify incomplete last mile delivery orders and last mile delivery service failures
desc: Determining orders which have not been completed or delivered. Identify the service orders that are partially or entirely incomplete, as well as the orders that have not been delivered to the customer. Use techniques such as project trackers to recognize the progress of the service orders.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Solicit customer feedback on last mile services delivered
desc: Obtaining and procuring customer reviews or feedback on the services delivered. Design a customer feedback form, or communicate with the customer through the phone or online.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

cat: Manage Supply Chain for Physical Products
name: Process customer feedback on last mile services delivered
desc: Assessing and incorporating customer reviews/feedback into the service plan to ensure high quality of service.
notes: Warehousing / logistics not applicable; drop-ship is handled under 4.2.4.

name: Deliver Services
desc: Offering services to customers. This is the act of providing service delivery as a core business practice and covers identifying strategies for performing service delivery, managing resources, and delivering services to the customer.
notes: Primary value-delivery category for both BUs.

name: Establish service delivery governance and strategies
desc: Creating rules and regulations for service delivery to the customer. Establish a system to manage performance, delivery, and direction of service delivery. Engage with the customer for satisfaction feedback. Define goals, policies, processes, and workplace layout and infrastructure as a part of the service delivery strategy.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Establish service delivery governance
desc: Establishing service delivery governance through a system that manages performance, development, and direction. Allow for customer feedback on delivery satisfaction.
