notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Set up and maintain service delivery governance and management system
desc: Providing a system for which to manage customer needs and a structure for which to facilitate service delivery to fulfill those needs.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Manage service delivery performance
desc: Conducting and implementing performance measures to ensure successful delivery of service to the customer.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Manage service delivery development and direction
desc: Providing guidance of resources to ensure that the development and direction of service delivery is in line with customer needs.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Solicit feedback from customer on service delivery satisfaction
desc: Engaging the customer post delivery to gauge the effectiveness of services rendered in order to improve on key delivery functions going forward.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Develop service delivery strategies
desc: Constructing strategies that identify goals, policies, processes, and procedures in relation to service delivery. Review and validate strategies. Define the workplace layout and infrastructure.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Define service delivery goals
desc: Aligning organization practices to meet the needs of the customer by creating service delivery goals.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Define labor policies
desc: Outlining labor policies for resources and ensuring that those policies meet the needs of the organization, the customer, and government regulations.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Evaluate resource availability
desc: Understanding the needs of the customer and providing the necessary resources to meet those requirements.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Define service delivery network and supply constraints
desc: Identifying and understanding the limitations imposed upon service delivery network and supply.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Define service delivery process
desc: Defanging policies and procedures that focus on meeting the needs and expectations of the customer within the working parameters of the organization.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Review and validate service delivery procedures
desc: Revisioning service delivery procedures that fall short of performance parameters. Realign procedures with specified expectations in order to provide successful service delivery.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Define service delivery workplace layout and infrastructure
desc: Creating a workplace that best serves the needs of the organization and customer through strategic layout and infrastructure.
notes: Service delivery governance - the Operations seat on the accountability chart.

name: Manage service delivery resources
desc: Understanding the demands on resources and creating a plan to enable the delivery of services via those resources.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Manage service delivery resource demand
desc: Ensuring necessary resources are maintained through monitoring pipeline, developing forecasts, and collaborating with customers. Determine skills needed for service deliver and forecast customer orders. Monitor forecasted orders and modify if where needed. Measure forecast accuracy.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Monitor pipeline
desc: Tracking potential opportunities as they move through the various stages of the pipeline.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Develop baseline forecasts
desc: Identifying the demand anticipated for the organization's services. Estimate future demand for services using historical data, analysis of the market environment, and external data.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Collaborate with customers
desc: Providing a collaborative meeting in which to engage the customer to understand the scope of their needs and constructing solutions based on need and constraints.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Develop consensus forecast
desc: Arriving at a consensus over the forecasted levels of demand for services by analyzing baseline forecasts and customer input.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Determine availability of skills to deliver on current and forecast customer orders
desc: Identifying what skillset is necessary for the delivery of opportunities. Determine the forecast of customer orders based upon those skillsets and the resources available.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Monitor activity against forecast and revise forecast
desc: Overseeing all activities necessary to deliver services to customer. Revise forecast to account for any issues that may arise. This could be changes in market trend, resource changes, etc.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Evaluate and revise forecasting approach
desc: Recognizing potential problems in the current forecast and making the necessary changes to align the forecast meet demand.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Measure forecast accuracy
desc: Analyzing forecasting against actuals to determine accuracy. Modify forecasting to align with actual need.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Create and manage resource plan
desc: Identifying the need for and creating a resource plan. Understand resource demand and align with capacity, skills, and capabilities. Enlist suppliers and partners to supplement needed skills and capabilities. Monitor and manage capabilities and skills with an eye on critical resources and supplier capacity.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Define and manage skills taxonomy
desc: Analyzing the skills needed to perform services to be delivered. Classify and organize these skills requirements.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Create resource plan
desc: Creating a plan to ensure that all resources are available to carry out services required for the customer. This can include physical resources and personnel.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Match resource demand with capacity, skills, and capabilities
desc: Matching demand with skills and capability. Enlisting suppliers and partners to help with demand when needed.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Collaborate with suppliers and partners to supplement skills and capabilities
desc: Understanding organizational need to enlist suppliers to provide resources for gaps in skills and capabilities. Identify where additional skills are needed and collaborate with third parties to fill those demands.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Identify critical resources and supplier capacity
desc: Realizing critical resources required to perform and carry out customer needs. Engage with suppliers to fulfill those needs, if necessary. Identify supplier threshold for performing those needs.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Monitor and manage resource capacity and availability
desc: Directing and managing workforce needs. Ensure that resources are at full capacity. Monitor that all resources are able to skilled in their respective rolls. Make sure that necessary resources are available to provide the needed services.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Enable service delivery resources
desc: Instituting training to enable resources to provide service delivery to the customer. Develop a training plan. Create materials that provide for operation and technical training. Schedule, perform, and evaluate training.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Develop service delivery training plan
desc: Creating a detailed summary of all the actions relevant to teaching a person a particular skill or type of behavior. Determine who will deliver the training. Determine when and where the apprentice or trainee needs to go to receive the structured component of the training.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Develop training materials
desc: Developing materials necessary to provide comprehensive training for the skills or behavior needed to deliver services. This can be any number for formats such as classroom or computer based training.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Manage training schedule
desc: Providing training to the employee within a manageable timeframe to meet the needs of both the individual and the organization.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Deliver operations training
desc: Educating service delivery personnel on all aspects of the operations process of the organization.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Deliver technical training
desc: Ensuring that all personnel are trained on all technical aspects of service delivery to include compliance with constraints on how advanced technologies including artificial intelligence (AI) are used.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Perform skill and capability testing
desc: Verifying that training provided to the person was successful through the administration testing and the application of skills for practical use.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Evaluate training effectiveness
desc: Eliciting feedback from various sources to evaluate the training provided. This can be achieved through testing and the practical application of skills. Additionally, manager or student feedback can be garnered to evaluate training effectiveness.
notes: Resource demand, capacity and utilization planning.

name: Manage and Operate Service Delivery System
desc: Managing and operating the systems, resources, and processes used to deliver services to customers, including planning, startup, ongoing operations, and service assurance.

name: Perform service delivery system planning
desc: Planning the service delivery system by defining service requirements, capacity, resources, and delivery approaches needed to support effective and reliable service provision.

name: Perform service delivery system startup
desc: Establishing and activating the service delivery system, including preparing resources, processes, and controls required to begin delivering services.

name: Operate service delivery system
desc: Executing day-to-day service delivery activities using the established service delivery system to meet service commitments, performance expectations, and customer needs.

name: Assure service delivery system service
desc: Monitoring and assuring service delivery system performance to maintain service quality, reliability, and compliance with defined service standards and expectations.

name: Deliver service to customer
desc: Rendering service to the customer by initiating, executing, and completing tasks associated with service delivery.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Initiate service delivery
desc: Collaborating with the customer to understand service needs. Review, understand, and modify the delivery scope with the organization needs of the customer in mind. Confirm readiness and identify, select, and assign resources. Plan for service delivery.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Review contract and agreed terms
desc: Meeting with the customer, partner, and/or supplier to review the terms of the solutions contract and agree on the terms set forth.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Understand customer requirements and define refine approach
desc: Taking the customer requirements for a solution and applying those requirements to a refined approach for service.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Modify/revise and approve project plan
desc: Updating the project plan to align with the new solution approach agreed upon with the customer.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Review customer business objectives
desc: Aligning the customer business objectives with the agreed service delivery solution.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Confirm environmental readiness
desc: Confirming that the organization has the recourses necessary to meet the expectations for the solution for service delivery.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Identify, select, and assign resources
desc: Identifying, selecting, and assigning resources required to deliver service to the customer. Ensure that all objectives are established and met, and the all rules of engagement have been identified and communicated.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Establish people objectives
desc: Providing the workforce with a plan of action and goals necessary to provide a service. Make sure that those objectives are met.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Establish engagement rules
desc: Establishing guidelines for how resources engage with the customer. For example, set rules of accountability, interaction, and accommodation when engaging the customer. Resources should be polite, empathetic, and attentive.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Plan for service delivery
desc: Establishing a plan of action to successfully render a solution for service delivery.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Execute service delivery
desc: Carrying out service delivery to the customer by creating and deploying the necessary solution. Analyze need and create a solution. Validate the solution and make changes if needed. Obtain approval to build/buy solution and then deploy solution to customer.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Analyze environment and customer needs
desc: Understanding the needs of the customer and providing the necessary resources to meet those requirements within the scope of the organization.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Define solution
desc: Creating a plan of action to provide service delivery to the customer through a possible solution. This solution should be in response to a collaborative effort made by the organization and the customer to meet service delivery needs.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Validate solution
desc: Validating that the proposed solution is feasible and provides the needed services for the customer.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Identify changes
desc: Realizing issues within the original drafted solution and providing changes to correct those issues.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Obtain approval to proceed
desc: Gaining approval from all avenues to proceed with providing solutions for service delivery.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Make build/buy solution
desc: Constructing or purchasing solutions necessary to provide service delivery.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Deploy solution
desc: Providing the customer with promised services and solutions.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Complete service delivery
desc: Implementing final steps to complete service delivery to the customer. Evaluate success through project review, complete finance activities, and confirm delivery. Release resources and manage completion by harvesting knowledge and systems by archiving records.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Conduct service delivery/project review and evaluate success
desc: Reviewing the entire service delivery process to evaluate the success of the project from beginning to end.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Complete/finalize financial management activities
desc: Insuring all payments are received and all activates therein are completed.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Confirm delivery according to contract terms
desc: Confirming that the organization has satisfied all terms of the delivery contract set forth in collaboration between the organization and customer.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Release resources
desc: Discharging leveraged resources from service delivery commitments upon completion. Returning resources to the resource pool.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Manage service delivery completion
desc: Ensuring that all aspects of the service delivery process are completed both internally and externally.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Harvest knowledge
desc: Garnering feedback from all avenues to collect a knowledge base concerning services rendered.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Archive records and update systems
desc: Completing and archiving all records associated with requested services. Update all necessary systems to reflect those changes.
notes: Engagement initiation through closeout; drives PS project profitability.

name: Manage Customer Service
desc: Managing interactions with current customers after the delivery of products and services. This includes developing and planning customer service practices with a focus on handling inquiries after sales, feedback, warranties, recalls, and other related processes.

name: Develop customer service strategy
desc: Defining a plan that removes customer obstacles by gathering operational insight and competitive insight, as well as improving soft skills and forward resolution for employees. Develop customer segmentation. Define rules and regulations for customer service. Establish service levels for customers.
notes: Service catalog, SLAs and target service levels by client segment.

name: Define customer service requirements across the enterprise
desc: Identifying the customer service requirements across the organization, including the needs and expectations of different customer segments. Additionally this includes defining a set of behaviors, skills, and policies needed to provide customer service effectively across the enterprise.
notes: Service catalog, SLAs and target service levels by client segment.

name: Define customer service experience
desc: Communicating how customer service interactions are handled including what is expected when engaging the customer. Relate service level expectations to the workforce. Ensure positive customer experience.
notes: Service catalog, SLAs and target service levels by client segment.

name: Define and manage customer service channel strategy
desc: Define the channels and communication methods that will be used to deliver customer service, including phone, email, chat, social media, and in-person interactions.
notes: Service catalog, SLAs and target service levels by client segment.

name: Define customer service policies and procedures
desc: Develop policies and procedures for delivering customer service, including handling customer complaints, resolving issues, and maintaining customer records.
notes: Service catalog, SLAs and target service levels by client segment.

name: Establish target service level for each customer segment
desc: Determining and implementing levels for customer services. Benchmark certain customer service practices, and base customer level services on those benchmarks. Create a service level agreement, which is an agreement designed to create a common understanding about services, priorities, and responsibilities.
notes: Service catalog, SLAs and target service levels by client segment.

name: Identify and define customer service strategy integrations
desc: Define how the customer service strategy will integrate with other departments like marketing, sales, and product development to ensure a seamless customer experience.
notes: Service catalog, SLAs and target service levels by client segment.

name: Plan and manage customer service contacts
desc: Planning and administering workforce operations for customer service provision by taking care of customer services requests/inquiries, as well as the complaints.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Plan and manage customer service workforce
desc: Creating and administering the workforce deployed for the customer service process. Forecast the customer workforce needs to correctly schedule the workforce. Track the utility of the workforce deployed. Examine the interactions between the customer and customer service representatives to achieve high quality.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Forecast volume of customer service contacts
desc: Projecting the total workforce required to service customer service inquiries in order to effectively predict the volume of vendor contracts required. Estimate the number of the customer service contracts in an agreed-upon time frame in order to strategically maintain the workforce necessitated for customer inquires. Analyze historical data around customer service contracts, the universe of customer inquiries, frequency of inquiries, servicing capability (per head) of the employees, etc.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Schedule customer service workforce
desc: Deploying the workforce to manage customer service contracts. Create a systematic summary of the operations and service required, as well as the specific amount of workforce that is to be deployed to the customer service operations. Ensure workforce is directly proportional to the estimated forecast of customer service contracts.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Track workforce utilization
desc: Tracking the utilization of workforce deployed for managing customer service operations. Monitor the utility of the workforce deployed for managing customer service operations in order to evaluate its efficiency and cost effectiveness. Calculate the overall labor effectiveness, which measures the utility, performance, and quality of the workforce.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Monitor and evaluate quality of customer interactions with customer service representatives
desc: Tracking and determining the quality of interactions between the customer and customer representatives. Use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to record and effectively assess customer representatives' interactions.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Manage customer service problems, requests, and inquiries
desc: Handling the requests and inquiries from customers that seek information regarding the organization's products/services. Obtain the customer requests online and by phone. Direct these requests to higher-level representatives. Approve requests, and respond to customers.
owner: Managed Technology (managed clients); Service Desk practice (enterprise Tier 1)
notes: System of record for the service desk; APQC 8.7.8 (Operate IT user support) cross-references this process.

name: Receive customer problems, requests, and inquiries
desc: Receiving requests for information from customers over multiple channels. Receive various requests and inquiries from customers regarding products/services. Accept these inquiries through channels such as email, telephone, online forms, text messages, social media, and in person. Supply dedicated equipment, systems, and personnel.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Analyze problems, requests, and inquiries
desc: Analyzing various requests and inquiries from customers regarding products/services. Provide answers and offerings to satisfy the customer's needs.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Resolve customer problems, requests, and inquiries
desc: Routing customer inquiries in order to service them with the most apposite response. Direct customer inquires to the best suited personnel or system. Have a system or procedure capable of efficiently channeling these requests.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Respond to customer problems, requests, and inquiries
desc: Responding to customer requests by email, conversation, interactive voice response, mail, etc. with the most appropriate reply. Instill a robust process to locate the right information for a solution to a customer's problem.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Identify and capture upsell/cross-sell opportunities
desc: Utilizing customer inquiries as opportunities to either provide a comparable service to the one in question, offer additional complimentary service, or suggest a service that is better than what was initially offered.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Deliver opportunity to sales team
desc: Providing possible sales leads to the sales team in an effort to garner more business opportunities.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Escalate client service issues by severity
desc: Classify and log the issue, acknowledge the client within the severity target (Critical 30 minutes, High 1 business hour, Medium 1 business day, Low 2 business days), send status updates on the severity cadence, and raise unresolved escalations to the next tier: Customer Success Manager, then the Director of Managed Services or Digital Transformation, then the Partner, then the Managing Director.

name: Attest to escalation roles
desc: Everyone in the escalation chain attests to the procedure on taking the role and at least annually.

name: Manage customer complaints
desc: Obtaining customer complaints online or by phone. Direct these complaints to higher-level representatives as appropriate. Resolve them. Respond to customers.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Receive customer complaints
desc: Receiving any complaints or grievances from customers for the organization's products/services. Receive objections, complaints, and criticism from customers regarding products/services through email, telephone, online forms, text messages, social media, in person, etc. Dedicate equipment, systems, and personnel.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Route customer complaints
desc: Routing any complaints or grievances received from customers in order to address them in the most appropriate manner. Direct complaints to the best suited personnel or system. Implement a system or procedure capable of efficiently channeling the various objections, complaints, and criticism from customers over the offerings provided by the organization.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Resolve customer complaints
desc: Resolving any customer complaints that are deemed to be sound and reasonable. Redress any objections, grievances, and complaints received from customers regarding the offerings provided by the organization. Identify the legitimate complaints, where the situation needs to be appropriately corrected. Deploy personnel who can rectify the issue within a stipulated time frame.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Respond to customer complaints
desc: Responding to customer complaints including all activities necessitated to service any objections, complaints, or grievances with the most appropriate reply. Source the right information to formulate a response that eases the discomfort being experienced by the customer. (Closely coordinate with Resolve customer complaints [10399].)
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Analyze customer complaints and response/redressal
desc: Analyzing complaint logs to provide input for continuous service improvement and customer profiling.
notes: The service desk. Ticket intake, triage, categorization and resolution.

name: Process returns
desc: Acquiring returns and identify if the returns are scraped or salvaged.
notes: Hardware RMA only.

name: Authorize return
desc: Approving and carrying forward the requests by the customers to return the product. This is part of the process of returning a product in order to receive a refund, replacement, or repair during the product's warranty period.
notes: Hardware RMA only.

name: Process return and record reason
desc: Notating the reason for the return of the product.
notes: Hardware RMA only.

name: Report incidents and risks to regulatory bodies
desc: Notifying all stakeholders, legal, and industry regulatory bodies of the incidents and risks related to a return or recall, if needed.
notes: Incident and breach reporting obligations to regulators and clients.

name: Service products after sales
desc: Assigning post-sales policies and paying claims on purchased products.  This is a process that is an administrative function focused on creating rules (claim codes). This group ensures that claims are valid and are processed quickly.  As well as to quickly determine responsibility for claim settlement.

name: Register products
desc: Filing product registrations.

name: Process warranty claims
desc: Identifying, investigating, and processes warranty claims. This process includes: receipt and validation of a warranty claim; definition and diagnosis /root cause analysis of an issue and recommendation for corrective action; the determination of responsibility for settlement of the claim; the transaction being approved or denied; and the originator being notified and payment authorized. In the case of a recurring event, further investigation (definition and diagnosis or root cause analysis) is performed, and a recommendation for corrective action is made and implemented in production/design. It ends when the claim is closed.

name: Receive warranty claim
desc: Receiving incoming warranty claims. Route claim to correct department. Document claim.

name: Validate warranty claim
desc: Ensuring that the claim falls within the parameters of the warranty in question. After validation is made, the claim must be investigated.

name: Investigate warranty issues
desc: Executing investigational and analysis of warranty claims. This involves notification and definition of a warranty issue, includes the scheduling of a field service agent to perform further investigation; the request and receipt of defective parts; and diagnosis/root cause analysis. This concludes with the receipt of the result and recommendation for corrective action.

name: Define issue
desc: Defining the issue of the claim. The warranty team will look into the issue and understand whether it is covered by the claim code or if more detail is required. Field service will be scheduled to further qualify the definition of the issue and to collect more evidence.

name: Schedule field service
desc: Scheduling additional investigative field service. This is performed for high priority claims or claims that require additional investigation. Field service engineers will gather additional information, perform further investigation, and qualify the definition of the issue.

name: Request and receive defective part
desc: Requesting receipt of a defective part for further investigation.

name: Investigate issue/perform root cause analysis
desc: Investigating claims by an appropriate functional representative. Once the issue has been clearly defined and diagnosed and a recommendation for corrective action is determined, it will be provided to the warranty management team.

name: Receive investigation result/recommendation for corrective action
desc: Receiving investigative results to assess claim approval or denial. The warranty team will assess the results of the investigation and the recommendations for corrective action.

name: Determine responsible party
desc: Identifying responsible party for a claim. There is no negotiation with the supplier at this point. There can be multiple warranties applicable to the same part: a new part warranty, a new product warranty (for the product the part is installed on), and a supplier warranty from the company that last repaired the part. The information required for this decision would be the output of Receive component/part and analyze fault [19728]."

name: Manage pre-authorizations
desc: Authorizing claims prior to submittal.

name: Approve or reject warranty claim
desc: Following Defining issue [20098], an approval or rejection with be made against the warranty claim. If it is deemed that the claim falls within the warranty parameters, the claim will be approved. If the claim is deemed to fall outside warranty parameters, the claim with be rejected.

name: Notify originator of approve/reject decision
desc: Contacting the originator of whether the warranty claim has been approved or rejected.

name: Authorize payment
desc: Allowing for a payment to be made to the claimant.

name: Close claim
desc: Archiving and closing the warranty claim after a final decision has been made to either approve or reject.

name: Reconcile warranty transaction disposition
desc: Assuring that the warranty transaction has been completed.

name: Manage supplier recovery
desc: Managing the recovery of costs from suppliers for individual claims.

name: Create supplier recovery claims
desc: Raising a supplier recovery claim. This is based off the decision made in Receive investigation result/recommendation for corrective action [20100].

name: Negotiate recoveries with suppliers
desc: Arranging the returns of recalled products to suppliers.

name: Service products
desc: Validating specific service requirements for individual customers. Determine and schedule resource to fulfill these requirements. Provide service to specific individual customers. Ensure the quality of service delivery.

name: Confirm specific service requirements for individual customer
desc: Acquiring or soliciting information about specific service requirements for individual customers through the customer service function. Obtain information about customer specific requests, process these requests, and create customer profiles to generate a service order.

name: Process customer request
desc: Soliciting or acquiring information using various sources such as databases, customer interactions, and customer request forms. Hand them further up the hierarchy to deal with them. Categorize the user's request, determining if the request is supportable and prioritizing the request.

name: Create customer profile
desc: Documenting the individual customer service requirements solicited, along with personal information of the customers, in order to generate customized profiles that hasten the delivery process.

name: Generate service order
desc: Designing a short-term agreement between the service provider and customer. One-time services are ordered by the service recipient and resource-related billing is performed upon completion. Use the service order to document service and customer service work.

name: Identify and schedule resources to meet service requirements
desc: Determining and scheduling the resources required to fulfill customer service requirements. Create a detailed schedule about the service orders and development of these service orders.

name: Create resourcing plan and schedule
desc: Developing a plan for sourcing and deploying the resources required to fulfill customer service needs. Document a detailed summary of all types of resources (equipment, finance, personnel, time, etc.) required to complete customer service requests and procure these resources. Identify and assess various sources in order to effectively create a resourcing plan.

name: Create service order fulfillment schedule
desc: Designing a detailed summary of customer service order requirements, along with information concerning the timing and duration for these services. Categorize the customer needs. Monitor the services delivered.

name: Provide service to specific customers
desc: Dispatching resources for managing and fulfilling daily service requirements. Manage the progress of order fulfillment. Complete order blocks.

name: Organize daily service order fulfillment schedule
desc: Laying out a daily plan of specific service orders that need to be fulfilled. Document and systematically order these activities to ensure high effectiveness and efficiency.

name: Execute product repair
desc: Dispatching and delivering the resources needed for the specific service requirements from the source/warehouse. Manage the dispatch, transportation, and delivery of the services.

name: Manage service order fulfillment
desc: Handling and managing orders fulfilled, along with the orders are not or partially fulfilled to track the order fulfillment progress. Use electronic devices such as trackers and GPS in order track and ensure delivery of the orders.

name: Ensure quality of service
desc: Guaranteeing the quality of service provided to customers. Identify the successful and unsuccessful orders along with the service failures. Collect customer feedback. Process the feedback to ensure the quality of service in the future.

name: Identify completed service orders for feedback
desc: Determining the service orders that have been successfully delivered. Identify the service orders completed and delivered to the customer. Leverage communication systems to ensure coordination with the customers in order to avoid mishaps.

name: Identify incomplete service orders and service failures
desc: Determining orders which have not been completed or delivered. Identify the service orders that are partially or entirely incomplete, as well as the orders that have not been delivered to the customer. Use techniques such as project trackers to recognize the progress of the service orders.

name: Solicit customer feedback on services delivered
desc: Obtaining and procuring customer reviews or feedback on the services delivered. Design a customer feedback form, or communicate with the customer through the phone or online.

name: Process customer feedback on services delivered
desc: Assessing and incorporating customer reviews/feedback into the service plan to ensure high quality of service.

name: Manage product recalls and regulatory audits
desc: Removing defective products from the distribution chain. Participate in audits from watchdog agencies.
notes: Product recall - not applicable.

name: Initiate recall
desc: Commencing the removal process of defective products.
notes: Product recall - not applicable.

name: Assess the likelihood and consequences of occurrence of any hazards
desc: Performing risk analysis. Identify all dangers, evaluate how probable they are, and what kinds of negative results or or adverse side effect they carry.
notes: Product recall - not applicable.

name: Manage recall related communications
desc: Handling communications that are related to product recalls.
notes: Product recall - not applicable.

name: Submit regulatory reports
desc: Creating and delivering reports to regulatory agencies to provide details about handling product recalls.
notes: Product recall - not applicable.

name: Monitor and audit recall effectiveness
desc: Analyzing the effectiveness of product recalls.
notes: Product recall - not applicable.

name: Manage recall termination
desc: Ending product recalls, communicating to the public and filing reports.
notes: Product recall - not applicable.

name: Evaluate customer service operations and customer satisfaction
desc: Calculating and assessing the operational activities of the customer service function. Evaluation is achieved through the customer requests/inquiries handling process, the customer complaint handling process, and product and services quality. Examine activities to ensure high levels of customer service.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Measure customer satisfaction with customer problems, requests, and inquiries handling
desc: Calculating satisfaction levels of customers by effectively evaluating the process of handling requests/inquiries of customers. Effectively calculate the performance of customer-requests/inquiries handling and resolution. Obtain information regarding requests/inquiries handling and resolution through customer feedback. Use it to explore new ideas and opportunities for enhanced customer requests/inquiries handling and resolution process.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Solicit customer feedback on customer service experience
desc: Creating an avenue for which the customer can provide feedback on their experience with how their inquiry, problem, or request was handled.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Analyze customer service data and identify improvement opportunities
desc: Reviewing customer service feedback to identify areas in which improvements can be made. Engage with management to discuss issues.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Provide customer feedback to product management on customer service experience
desc: Handing over data to management to analyze common issues in regards to customer service.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Measure customer satisfaction with customer- complaint handling and resolution
desc: Measuring the satisfaction level of customers as pertains to how their complaints are handled and resolved. This process element requires the organization to estimate the customers level of fulfillment with the process reconciling their complaints and towards the objective of ensuring customer retention. The feedback received can be used to develop concepts for new opportunities to boost the level of customer satisfaction.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Solicit customer feedback on complaint handling and resolution
desc: Requesting customer feedback on the process of handling and resolving customer complaints. Obtain information about the effectiveness and performance of the customer complaint handling process from the customers through various means (e.g., online and by phone).
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Analyze customer complaint data and identify improvement opportunities
desc: Examining the information obtained through handling and resolving complaints for development/improvement opportunities. Categorize the customer complaints data on the basis of speed, accuracy, courtesy, price, product choice, availability, hours, location, etc. Determine complaint patterns in order to diagnose areas needing enhancement.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Identify common customer complaints
desc: Determining complaint patterns in order to identify common issues. Document common problems for correction.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Measure customer satisfaction with products and services
desc: Calculating satisfaction levels of customers with products/services. Obtain customer feedback on products/services, as well as the effectiveness of the advertising campaigns. Examine this information to reach meaningful conclusions, which could then be used to enhance the customer service operations.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Gather and solicit post-sale customer feedback on products and services
desc: Obtaining customer feedback/review on the quality and utility derived from the products/services after the sale is complete. Use techniques such as surveys, feedback boxes, and user activity and usability tests.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Solicit post-sale customer feedback on promotion effectiveness
desc: Assessing the influence of promotions on purchasing behavior. Use techniques such as surveys and product recognition tests, questionnaires or feedback flyers, and toll-free numbers in order to encourage customer interaction after the sale.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Solicit customer feedback on cross-channel experience
desc: Engaging with the customer to understand their cross-channel experience. Find out what channels were effective and what areas need improvement.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Analyze product and service satisfaction data and identify improvement opportunities
desc: Assessing the information collected on customer satisfaction levels with products/services in order to determine areas for improvement. Examine the data and information extracted from the customer feedback and reviews to measure the satisfaction levels of the customers. Identify opportunities that could enhance the customer satisfaction levels and the overall customer service strategy.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Provide feedback and insights to appropriate teams (product design/development, marketing, manufacturing)
desc: Providing feedback from customers on products/services to the product management team. Analyze information collected through Gather and solicit post-sale customer feedback on products/services [11238]. Share with the product management team for consideration while improving existing offerings or developing new products/services.
notes: CSAT / NPS and service desk health measurement.

name: Evaluate and manage warranty performance
desc: Assessing the cost and effectiveness of warranties.

name: Measure customer satisfaction with warranty handling and resolution
desc: Evaluating how satisfied customers are with how product warranties are managed and resolved.

name: Monitor and report on warranty management metrics
desc: Comparing warranties by using applicable metrics to see how they are handled and resolved. Develop and submit reports that summarize significant conclusions.

name: Identify improvement opportunities
desc: Determining how warranties and warranty management can be made better and more efficient.

name: Identify opportunities to eliminate warranty waste
desc: Finding ways to phase out unused or seldom used warranties.

name: Investigate fraudulent claims
desc: Reviewing and assessing claims that contain deliberately incorrect information or that have been submitted with the goal to deceive the system.

name: Evaluate recall performance
desc: Reviewing customer service feedback to identify areas in which improvements can be made. Engage with management to discuss issues.

name: Develop and Manage Human Resources
desc: Delivering processes traditionally defined as "human resources". Process groups include those related to developing and maintaining workforce strategy, recruiting employees, developing and counseling employees, managing employee relations, rewarding and retaining employees, redeploying and retiring employees, managing employee information, and managing employee communications.

name: Develop and manage human resources (HR) planning, policies, and strategies
desc: Creating strategies for the HR function. Create and implement strategies for managing the work force. Supervise and enhance the strategies, plans, and policies supporting the HR function. Developing models for managing competency levels of the HR of the organization.

name: Develop human resources strategy
desc: Creating a long-term plan that strategically aligns human resources with the company's goals. The HR function's focus is to ensure the organization has the necessary talent and capabilities to achieve its objectives, sustain its competitive advantage, and reduce employee turnover.

name: Identify strategic HR needs
desc: Strategically defining the current and future needs for developing an efficient HR strategy.

name: Define HR and business function roles and accountability
desc: Outlining the charge and duty of the HR function by defining its responsibility areas, as well as ensuring its accountability. Establish the HR function by laying out the roles and responsibilities for this function and the rules and regulations guiding HR. Define the goals and objectives of the HR, as well as a mission and vision for this function. Create a mechanism involving a set of policies, code of conduct, and institutional procedure to ensure HR accountability.

name: Determine HR function roles and structure
desc: Establishing the roles that are required to execute the HR function.  This process also examines the organizational structure required to support the organization.

name: Determine HR delivery model
desc: Determining how an organization's human resources department offers services to and interacts with employees.

name: Determine HR costs
desc: Ascertaining the costs and expenses of the HR function. Identify and report HR investments using, for example, a cost approach or a present value of future earnings approach.

name: Establish HR measures
desc: Evaluating the performance of HR function. Lay out the course of HR procedures that would formulate a plan of action needed to fulfill strategic HR needs. Deploy measures such as hiring policies, leave management, internal code of conducts, and compensation structure.

name: Communicate HR strategies
desc: Conveying the strategies of HR function to employees and management. Effectively explain the vision, plans, and anticipated benefits of the HR strategy to employees, as well as the public. Develop statements and messages that are easy to read, informative, and relevant to the audience.

name: Develop strategy for HR systems/technologies/tools
desc: Creating a strategy for the use of systems/technologies/tools in operating the HR function. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI). Create a strategy concerning the use and utility of HR support tools and technologies. Decide what specific tools to use and in what quantity. Determine the levels of technology required for the HR management.

name: Manage employer branding
desc: Creating, maintaining and communicating company's reputation and values to keep current employees and attract potential hires.

name: Design the employee experience
desc: Designing the intended end-to-end employee experience across key moments in the employee lifecycle to support engagement, performance, retention, and alignment with organizational culture and workforce objectives.

name: Develop and implement workforce planning, policies, and strategies
desc: Creating and executing strategies and policies for smooth administration of workforce. Determine and gather skill requirements. Plan the requirements for employee resourcing per unit. Create compensation, succession, HR program, and employee diversity plans. Develop and administer policies for HR. Develop benefits for employees. Create models for work force strategies.

name: Perform strategic workforce planning
desc: Evaluating the current and future skill requirements of the organization with regard to the overall corporate strategy of the organization and market conditions. Identify and establish the minimum skills needed for the requisite HR needs.

name: Develop and manage strategic workforce planning framework
desc: Defining and maintaining the structure, principles, and approaches used to assess workforce supply and demand, capabilities, and gaps over the strategic planning horizon.

name: Perform business unit workforce planning
desc: Determining the requirements for employees and the need for employee resourcing for each unit/function. Lay out a plan detailing employee resourcing requirements of individual functions and the organization as a whole.

name: Advise business in implementing strategic workforce planning
desc: Providing guidance and expertise to business leaders on applying the strategic workforce planning framework to inform workforce decisions, plans, and initiatives.

name: Partner with the business to execute workforce plan
desc: Collaborating with business leaders to translate workforce plans into actionable initiatives and to support execution of agreed workforce actions.

name: Monitor and adjust strategic workforce plan
desc: Tracking workforce outcomes and changes in business needs to update workforce plans and address emerging gaps, risks, or opportunities.

name: Develop total compensation and rewards strategy
desc: Designing a plan that specifies the combination of wages, salaries, and benefits the employees receive in exchange for work. Define the total amount of compensation, in addition to the manner in which the compensation is paid and the purposes for which employees can receive bonuses, salary increases, incentives and non-monetary rewards.

name: Establish wages, salaries, and benefits strategy
desc: Defining the strategic approach for wages, salaries, and benefits to support workforce attraction, retention, performance, and alignment with organizational objectives and market conditions.

name: Establish incentive strategy
desc: Creating a scheme of rewards and recognition for employees to promote a results-based culture. Create specific incentives to reach desired outcomes, such as landing key clients, growing the customer base, providing exceptional servicing, and increasing profit margins.

name: Establish a severance pay strategy
desc: Defining the approach to severance pay, including principles and guidelines, to support workforce transitions while managing financial, legal, and reputational considerations.

name: Develop succession plan
desc: Creating and implementing the plan for continuation of key positions within the organization. Identify internal people with the potential to fill key business leadership positions. Provide critical development experiences to employees who can move into important roles. Engage leaders to support the development of high-potential leaders.

name: Develop high performers/leadership programs
desc: Creating a program that incorporates incentives and compensation put forth by the organization to recognize high performing workers and excellence in leadership.

name: Develop diversity, equity, and inclusion plan
desc: Creating and implementing the plan for ensuring a diverse work force. Develop and hire employees with varying characteristics including, but not limited to, religious and political beliefs, gender, ethnicity, education, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, and geographic location.

name: Implement diversity, equity, and inclusion plan
desc: Execution of diversity, equity, and inclusion plans within an organization.  Often called a DEI plan.

name: Design talent acquisition program
desc: Developing a program to entice prospective resources to engage with the organization for a position of employment.

name: Design talent development program
desc: Identifying skills, knowledge, and attributes that need enhancement in order to perform a job. Develop the appropriate training programs. These programs can be computer-based, classroom, or on-the-job training, etc.

name: Develop other HR programs
desc: Creating HR programs and services such as employee engagements programs to promote positive employee behavior. Create a variety of programs and services to support employees' professional and personal needs at work and at home.

name: Develop HR policies
desc: Creating rules and regulations that govern the HR function. Develop a policy plan that serves as a guideline for setting rules and regulations that help in achieving the HR goals and objectives.

name: Administer HR policies
desc: Ensuring rules and regulations are followed and are flexible enough to accommodate indispensable deviations.

name: Plan employee benefits
desc: Planning benefits in kind (also called fringe benefits, perquisites, or perks). Include various types of non-wage compensations provided to employees in addition to normal wages or salaries.

name: Develop workforce strategy models
desc: Creating and implementing models for effectively strategizing the work force of the organization. Develop a model that specifies the organization's overall approach for maximizing the performance of its work force by defining the goals, objectives, and expectations of the work force. Manage all aspects of performance required for the work force to function, including recruitment, selection, retention, and professional development.

name: Implement workforce strategy models
desc: Implementing models for effectively strategizing the work force of the organization. Carry out all aspects of performance required for the work force to function, including recruitment, selection, retention, and professional development.

name: Manage job families
desc: Overseeing a group of similar individual or teams with similar education, skills, training, or experience.

name: Develop and maintain job descriptions
desc: Creating descriptions for job requisitions. Define the normal components of a job description, such as the overall position description with general areas of responsibility listed, essential functions of the job described with a couple of examples of each, required knowledge, skills, abilities, required education and experience, a description of the physical demands, and a description of the work environment.

name: Monitor and update HR strategies, plans, and policies
desc: Supervising the HR and workforce strategy, plans, and policies in order to refurbish them whenever needed. Determine the performance of HR and workforce plans and policies by measuring the objective achievement rate and its contribution to the overall business strategy. Ensure that information about these plans and strategies is effectively communicated to various stakeholders. Incorporate any suggestions by these stakeholders when revising HR and workforce plans and policies.

name: Measure realization of HR objectives
desc: Determining the accomplishment of HR and workforce goals and objectives. Evaluate the effectiveness of the HR function by estimating the present rate of achievement of the established objectives. Use metrics to determine if the objectives are being realized. Leverage measures such as turnover, training, return on human capital, costs of labor, and expenses per employee.

name: Measure contribution of HR to business strategy
desc: Determining the role of the HR function in implementing the organizational strategy. Measure the correlation between the HR and workforce performance and the overall business strategy. Calculate the amount of contribution of the HR function to the overall business growth.

name: Communicate HR plans and provide updates to stakeholders
desc: Conveying the plans for HR function to stakeholders. Ensure that the HR plans and strategy are effectively communicated to the people who can affect or be affected by the organization's actions, objectives, and policies such as the creditors, shareholders, employees, and suppliers. Provide regular updates to these stakeholders to ensure effective communication.

name: Review and revise HR plans
desc: Reassessing the strategies, plans, and policies of the HR function, with the objective of revising them. Revisit the schematic plans for the HR function. Taking stock of any suggestions or feedback from the stakeholders, revamp the blueprint of HR strategies and plans.

name: Develop competency management models
desc: Creating and implementing the tools for managing the competency levels of HR. Design a model for integrating HR planning with business planning. Assess current HR capacity based on the competencies against the capacity needed to achieve the vision, mission, and business goals of the organization. Consider factors such as employee development, career path, compensation policies, and performance management.
notes: Technical competency model - ties to Halo skills and utilization.

name: Recruit, source, and select employees
desc: Determining and handling employee requirements. Recruit or source the candidates as per the requirements. Screen and select the most appropriate candidates. Take care of the newly hired and re-hired employees. Maintain records of information for all applicants.

name: Manage employee requisitions
desc: Handling the requirements for new employees. Create and open job requisitions by clearly defining the job descriptions. Post these requirements internally and externally, and modify them as appropriate. Manage the dates of the whole requisition process.

name: Align staffing plan to work force plan and business unit strategies/resource needs
desc: Creating a correspondence between the plan for hiring new employees and the desired employee requirements. Staff an adequate amount of people with the appropriate skills to effectively accomplish its legislative, regulatory, service, and production requirements.

name: Open job requisitions
desc: Developing specific job requisitions, and ensuring their accessibility. Create and open a job requisition to fill the vacant positions within the organization. Clearly describe the job title, department, fill date, and the requisite skills and qualifications for the job.

name: Approve job requisition
desc: Reviewing and authorizing requests to fill positions to ensure alignment with workforce plans, budget constraints, and organizational approval requirements

name: Post job requisitions
desc: Posting and advertising job descriptions. Display open job descriptions internally and externally. Use public portals, online portals, and websites to upload these requisitions in order for applications to be received.

name: Modify job requisitions
desc: Making the necessary alterations to job requisitions. Revamp or revise the job requisitions in case a position is filled or is not vacant anymore, as well as in case of any new openings. (It involves Manage the internal/external job posting websites [10449] to make the necessary changes.)

name: Notify hiring manager
desc: Informing and communicating with the hiring manager. Notify the manager responsible for the hiring process in cases of any new position openings or changes.

name: Manage requisition dates
desc: Determining and managing the dates for the employee requisition process.

name: Recruit/Source candidates
desc: Recruiting new candidates for deployment across various functional areas inside the organization. Select methods for sourcing new employees. Manage relationships with third-party agencies. Stage recruitment fairs and drives. Manage employee referral programs.

name: Determine recruitment methods and channels
desc: Defining the methods and channels for recruitments in order to maximize the amount of candidate availability. Use channels such as headhunting, job postings, job portals, networking websites, and media advertising. Choose from the various methods of recruitment such as internal/external third-party sourcing.

name: Perform recruiting activities/events
desc: Organizing and executing recruiting activities and events. Activities and events include on-campus hiring, refresher courses, information sessions, career fairs, etc. to increase the coverage of the sourcing in order to ensure that the most deserving and appropriate candidates are hired.

name: Develop and maintain candidate pool
desc: Cultivating relationships with potential job candidates even when there are no immediate openings. Building the talent pipeline for potential future hiring needs.

name: Manage recruitment vendors
desc: Establishing and maintaining relationships with recruitment vendors (suppliers). Create and maintain relationships with third-party agencies such as staffing and firms to expand. Use these relationships to implement the sourcing process effectively.

name: Manage employee referral programs
desc: Creating and managing a recruiting strategy where current employees are rewarded for referring qualified candidates for employment.

name: Manage recruitment channels
desc: Establishing and maintaining internal and external channels for recruiting. Extract the best out of every recruitment channel. Manage all the processes related to all the sourcing channels including maintaining career pages on the organization website.

name: Screen and select candidates
desc: Evaluating and selecting potential employees through interviews, tests, etc.

name: Identify and deploy candidate selection tools
desc: Identifying and implementing tools for the selection of candidates. Recognize candidate selection tools such as screening, telephone interviews, hiring manager interviews, drug testing, and skills assessment. Effectively deploy these tools to check if the candidates fit in the workplace or not, as well as to ensure workplace safety.

name: Interview candidates
desc: Assessing the candidates by their performance in the interviews. Conduct HR interview, technical interview, hiring manager interview, etc. Understand the mindset of the candidate, and comprehend his/her personal and professional lives.

name: Test candidates
desc: Examining the candidates through tests. Prepare tools such as aptitude, technical, and grammar tests. Test the skills of the candidate through a written, oral, or computerized test.

name: Select and reject candidates
desc: Approving the deserving candidates, and rejecting the others. Examining the performance of candidates. Ensure candidates would fit well with the organization. (Assess performance from Interview candidates [10457] and Test candidates [10458].)

name: Manage new hire/re-hire
desc: Creating and making job offers to the selected candidates. Fairly negotiate the job offers. Agree on terms with the candidate to complete the hiring process.

name: Draw up and make offer
desc: Compiling job-related information for the selected candidates in order to make up a job. Include information about the job description, reporting relationship, salary, bonus potential, benefits, and vacation allotment.

name: Negotiate offer
desc: Negotiating an offer with selected candidates. Discuss the job offer with the candidate to ensure a mutual understanding.

name: Hire candidate
desc: Wrapping up the process for hiring candidates. Agree to all hiring terms and conditions. Have the candidate accept and sign the job offer.

name: Manage applicant information
desc: Creating and maintaining a system for managing the information of applicants. Create records for all candidates who apply. Maintain and track information through the use applicant-tracking systems.

name: Obtain candidate background information
desc: Conducting a background investigation on the candidates with the objective of gathering and compiling criminal, commercial, medical, and financial information.

name: Create applicant record
desc: Creating and documenting the records of all applicants. Manage all individual applicants, including hires and non-hires. Maintain records to avoid any duplication and promote efficiency.

name: Manage/Track applicant data
desc: Keeping track of all the information about the candidates who apply for jobs. Use applicant-tracking systems that can be accessed online as a central location and database for recruitment efforts.

name: Complete position classification and level of experience
desc: Identifying the requirements for the position to be filled. Determine the experience and skills necessary to perform the tasks outlined.

name: Archive and retain records of non-hires
desc: Retaining and storing the records of the candidates who were rejected and not hired to ensure future availability in case the need arises. Create a centralized repository of profiles. Label these records in order to readily identify them. Add remarks for any future consideration.

name: Manage employee onboarding, training, and development
desc: Assisting employees in developing their capabilities, and providing them counseling services. Handle the orientation and deployment of the employees. Administer the performance of employees. Administer the development and enhancement of the employees. Provide training and development programs for employees.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Manage employee onboarding
desc: Creating and maintaining various employee on-boarding programs typically known as induction programs in order to ensure that the new employees are effectively introduced to the organization and its existing employees. Examine and evaluate the performance of these induction programs. Execute these programs on the ground level.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Develop employee onboarding program
desc: Creating and maintaining a mechanism through which new employees acquire the necessary knowledge, skills, and behaviors to become effective organizational members and insiders. Conduct formal meetings, lectures, videos, printed materials, and/or computer-based orientations to introduce newcomers to their new jobs and the organization.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Implement employee onboarding program
desc: Bringing the employee on-boarding program into effect. Implement Develop employee onboarding program [10474]. Conduct training sessions and employee engagement programs.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Monitor and update employee onboarding program
desc: Assessing the performance and effectiveness of employee on-boarding program. Examine the performance of on-boarding program through feedback and reviews from the new employees. Create web and written forms. Obtain information through face-to-face discussions.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Manage employee performance
desc: Defining individual performance objectives. Review performance in order to provide appraisals. Evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of the current performance program. Update it regularly.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Define employee performance objectives
desc: Outlining the objectives for employee performance. Establish key performance objectives and measures such as customer-focus objectives, financially focused objectives, and employee growth objectives.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Review employee performance
desc: Execution of employee reviews/performance on a frequent basis. May include ongoing feedback and coaching activities.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Document employee performance
desc: Document the results of both formal reviews to include both positive and negative feedback and commentary. May include acknowledgement by involved parties.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Monitor and update performance program
desc: Assessing and revamping performance programs, including the instruments used to measure employee performance standards. Review and upgrade these performance programs to avoid any deprivations and ensure effectiveness.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Manage employee career development
desc: Establishing employee development guidelines. Lay out career paths and plans for individual employees. Manage the development of their skills to enhance their skills, ability, and knowledge.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Define employee development guidelines
desc: Outlining the guidelines for development of employees. Design development policies and procedures to identify areas of growth for employees, either in their current position or in preparation for future roles. Include topics related to knowledge and skill development.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Develop employee career plans and career paths
desc: Designing a future career path for the employees that encourages them to explore and gather information.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Manage employee skill and competency development
desc: Administering the development of employee skills. Conduct training, coaching and mentoring, job-rotation and cross training, lateral moves, etc. Maintain records of employee skills and competencies.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Establish succession plans
desc: Establishing plans to ensure continuity in critical roles by identifying potential successors and preparing them for future leadership or specialist positions.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Identify critical roles
desc: Determining roles that are essential to organizational performance or continuity and that require succession planning.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Select potential successors
desc: Identifying and selecting employees with the potential to assume critical roles based on defined criteria and future capability requirements.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Develop and implement individual succession plans
desc: Creating and executing development plans for identified successors to prepare them for future roles through targeted learning and experience opportunities.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Review and update succession plans
desc: Reviewing succession plans on a regular basis and updating them to reflect changes in roles, talent, organizational priorities, and performance outcomes.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Develop and train employees
desc: Establish organizational development needs for employees. Creating a link between employee and organizational development needs.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Align organizational development needs to employees
desc: Identifying the skills, competencies, and knowledge required by the organization to achieve its strategic goals and ensuring employees' growth directly contributes to achieving those goals.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Define employees competencies and skills
desc: Defining the skills, knowledge, abilities, and attributes needed to achieve the desired core capabilities and competencies of the organization.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Align learning programs with competencies and skills
desc: Aligning the learning programs with the core capabilities and competencies of the organization. Contextualize the training programs so that employees can expand their knowledge base and add new skills in line with the core competencies of the organization.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Establish training needs by analysis of required and available skills
desc: Determining the training necessitated by business processes, using an examination of skill sets that are needed by the organization and those already possessed. Examine the various skills required by individual employees. Design training in light of the availability of resources to provide specific segments of training.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Develop, conduct, and manage employee training programs
desc: Creating, implementing, and managing the programs for training employees. Create and design sessions on the basis of the needs and the availability of the skills. Conduct the sessions in person or virtually. Manage all aspects related to the training programs. Consider including literacy training, interpersonal skills training, technical training, problem-solving training, diversity or sensitivity training, etc.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Manage examinations and certifications
desc: Managing identified training programs for employees. Engage with industries to provide certifications, administer certification test, and maintain active certification.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Liaise with external certification authorities
desc: Coordinating with third party certification authorities to provide training and certifications for necessary skills.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Administer certification tests
desc: Providing tests to the workforce that will satisfy completion of certifications.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Appraise experience qualifications
desc: Ascertaining the experience level needed to qualify for a specific job or certification within the organization. Some certificates require practical experience as well as training programs.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Administer certificate issue and maintenance
desc: Administering certificates to all candidates that have successfully met experience qualifications, and passed all tests necessary to obtain the certificate.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Monitor and evaluate learning programs
desc: Oversight of the organization's learning programs.  This process also includes the effectiveness of these programs.
notes: Onboarding, quarterly conversations and development - EOS People component.

name: Manage employee relations
