desc: Assisting general management in developing, maintaining, and improving employee relationships. This is accomplished through communication, performance management, processing grievances, and/or dispute. Interpret and convey organizational policies.

name: Manage labor relations
desc: Managing labor relations, the collective bargaining process, and the relationships between the labor and management. Take care of employee grievances.

name: Manage collective bargaining process
desc: Managing any negotiations between an employer and a group of employees that determine the conditions of employment. Engage employees to reach agreements in regulating working conditions.
notes: No collective bargaining unit.

name: Manage labor management partnerships
desc: Handling partnerships between labor and management. Develop a lasting two-way relationship that is beneficial for the labor, management, and the organization.

name: Manage employee grievances
desc: Taking care or resolving any complaint raised by an employee by procedures provided for in a collective agreement, an employment contract, or by other mechanisms established by an employer.

name: Monitor legal and regulatory environment
desc: Awareness of the employee legislature that is in place for the organization.  The regulatory environment could include areas, regions, countries, or technologies (around AI, for example).

name: Reward and retain employees
desc: Creating frameworks for rewarding and recognizing employees with the objective of retaining them. Create and manage programs for provision of rewards, recognition, and motivation. Manage and administer the benefits for employees. Help assist and retain employees. Administer payroll to employees.

name: Develop and manage reward, recognition, and motivation programs
desc: Developing a salary/compensation structure and plan; developing a benefits and reward plan; develop commission plan; performing competitive analyses of benefits and rewards; identifying compensation requirements based on compensation, benefits, and HR policies; administering compensation, commission, and rewards to employees; and rewarding and motivating employees.

name: Develop salary/compensation structure and plan
desc: Creating the framework for the provision of salary/compensation to employees. Break down the salary structure into different components such as fixed pay, variable pay, bonus, and allowances such medical allowance, and rent allowance, etc. Develop, adjust, and maintain a pay structure.

name: Develop benefits and rewards plan
desc: Developing a plan for provision of rewards, commission, and benefits to employees. Plan health benefits, retirement benefits, wellness plans, and non-monetary benefits, etc.

name: Perform competitive analysis of benefits and rewards
desc: Analyzing and evaluating the organization's benefits and rewards plan. Compare/Benchmark the benefits and employees plan with other organizations to adhere to industry standard practices.

name: Identify compensation requirements based on financial, benefits, and HR policies
desc: Recognizing the employee requirements for compensation on the basis of the financial, benefits, and HR policies of the organization. Recognize individual compensation requirements regarding the financial policies of the organization. Consider the benefits plan and overall HR policies while selecting compensation requirements.

name: Administer compensation and rewards to employees
desc: Managing the provision of compensations and rewards to the employees while maintaining consistency with the compensation and benefits plan. Follow the compensation and benefits plan rigorously in order to avoid any discrepancies.

name: Reward and motivate employees
desc: Rewarding and stimulating the performance efforts of employees. Create methods for motivating employees. Spur extrinsic and intrinsic motivation.

name: Review engagement and retention indicators
desc: Reassessing the indicators for retention and motivation of employees. Monitor the indicators that signal the levels of motivation and retention. Regularly update and upgrade indicators to avoid depreciation and ensure high efficiency.

name: Review compensation plan
desc: Analyzing existing compensation plans and making changes necessary to continue to retain employees.

name: Review benefits and rewards plan
desc: Evaluating benefits and rewards plans to assess effectiveness, alignment with workforce needs, and consistency with organizational reward and recognition objectives.

name: Manage and administer benefits
desc: Managing and ensuring benefits enrollment by the employees. Process any benefit claims made by the employees. Balance the estimated amount and entitled amount of benefits.

name: Deliver employee benefits program
desc: Implementing the programs that specify employee benefits, other than salary provided, such as those concerning medical care, death, and disability.

name: Administer benefit enrollment
desc: Handling the employee enrollment for obtaining benefits. Manage employee enrollment and eligibility, including work and life status/event changes. Encourage employees to enroll for benefits.

name: Process benefits claims
desc: Processing any formal requests or demands made by the employees claiming that they have earned some benefits. Includes escalation to management.

name: Perform benefit reconciliation
desc: Carrying out reconciliation of benefits delivered to employees. Compare the estimated benefit requirement made by the employee and the actual amount of benefits the employee is entitled to receive.

name: Manage employee assistance and retention
desc: Managing activities centered around delivering programs to support work/life balance for employees; developing family support systems; reviewing retention and motivation indicators; and reviewing compensation plans.

name: Deliver programs to support work/life balance for employees
desc: Designing programs that prompt proper balance between work (i.e., career and ambition) and lifestyle (i.e., health, pleasure, leisure, family, and spiritual development/meditation). Account for dependent care, flexible working arrangements, leaves of absence, on-the-job training, etc.

name: Manage flexible working
desc: Creation and execution of a plan that might allow for work from home days, or alternate hours.

name: Manage transportation programs and services
desc: Managing transportation-related programs and services provided to employees to support commuting, mobility, and work/life balance objectives.

name: Develop employee and family support systems
desc: Creating a support structure that aligns with local and federal laws that allow for support for families. This could include things like maternity leave, care for a family member, or in some cases, extended sick leave.

name: Administer Payroll
desc: Managing the sum of all financial records of salaries for an employee, including wages, bonuses, and deductions. Use a payroll management system to deal with the financial aspects of employees' salaries, allowances, deductions, gross pay, net pay, etc. Generate pay slips for a specific period.

name: Manage/Collect employee suggestions and perform employee research
desc: Procuring and handling suggestions from employees, and performing research on employees. Manage and analyze the programs that help the organization to tap into employee ideas for improving the organization's processes and/or products. Use surveys, focus groups, and other data-gathering methods to find out the attitudes, opinions, and feelings of members of an organization.

name: Redeploy and retire employees
desc: Managing employee mobility and retirement. Manage the process of employee promotion and demotion. Administer separation, retirement, and leaves of absence. Outplace employees. Deploy personnel. Relocate employees in order to manage assignments.
notes: Separation must trigger identity and access de-provisioning (see 8.3.8).

name: Manage promotion and demotion process
desc: Administering the process of promoting and demoting employees. Design a system for advancing or demoting an employee's rank or position. Leverage techniques such as horizontal promotion, vertical promotion, dry promotion, and involuntary/voluntary demotion.
notes: Separation must trigger identity and access de-provisioning (see 8.3.8).

name: Manage separation
desc: Managing the process of employee separation, including leaves of absence, resignations, discharges, and layoffs. Inform the employee of the termination. Complete paperwork for continuation of benefits. Enter employment status change into system.
notes: Separation must trigger identity and access de-provisioning (see 8.3.8).

name: Manage retirement
desc: Managing and administering instances where a person stops employment completely.
notes: Separation must trigger identity and access de-provisioning (see 8.3.8).

name: Manage leave of absence
desc: Managing the period of time that an employee must be away from their primary job, while maintaining the status of employee (i.e., paid and unpaid leave of absence but not vacations, holidays, hiatuses, sabbaticals, and work-from-home programs).
notes: Separation must trigger identity and access de-provisioning (see 8.3.8).

name: Manage offboarding
desc: Coordinating activities related to employee departures, including transitions, knowledge transfer, and administrative actions, to support orderly and compliant workforce exits.
notes: Separation must trigger identity and access de-provisioning (see 8.3.8).

name: Develop and implement employee outplacement
desc: Helping former employees transition to new jobs or to re-orient themselves in the job market. Deliver help through one-on-one sessions or in a group format. Provide guidance in career evaluation, resume writing, interview preparation, developing networks, and job searching.
notes: Separation must trigger identity and access de-provisioning (see 8.3.8).

name: Relocate employees and manage assignments
desc: Managing the relocation of employees in order to carry out assignments. Manage internal business processes to transfer employees, their families, and/or entire departments of a business to a new location.

name: Manage expatriates
desc: Manage employees who are sent to live abroad or hired from abroad for a defined time period.

name: Manage employee information and analytics
desc: Managing the employee reporting processes, employee inquiry process, employee information and data, and the HR information systems. Create and administer the employee metrics. Develop and handle the time and attendance systems. Refurbish the indicators for employee retention and motivation.

name: Manage reporting processes
desc: Providing information and reports regarding employees to management.

name: Manage employee inquiry process
desc: Handling instances where an employee believes that he/she has been inappropriately treated or he/she desires clarification. Encourage employees to inquire when needed. Record and clarify the issues for which the enquiry has been made.

name: Manage and maintain employee data
desc: Capturing and updating employee information and data and information on the employees.

name: Manage human resource information systems
desc: Administering and maintaining HR information systems that take care of activities related to HR, accounting, management, and payroll.

name: Develop and manage employee measures
desc: Creating and maintaining performance metrics for employees. Create and manage a strategic system of data and statistics to accurately gauge each employee's information. Consider productivity metrics, efficiency metrics, training metrics, etc.

name: Develop and manage time and attendance systems
desc: Developing and maintaining systems for managing the time and attendance of employees. Routinely upgrade the process and systems that track when employees start and stop work, the department where the work is performed, attendance in addition to tracking meals and breaks, the type of work performed, and the number of items produced.
notes: Time capture is the input to utilization, PS margin and billing.

name: Develop workforce analytics
desc: Understand, develop, and gather workforce data in support of stakeholder requirements.

name: Determine stakeholder requirements
desc: Collect and manage requirements from various enterprise stakeholders about workforce analytics.

name: Identify research questions
desc: Summarize stakeholder requirements into discrete research questions in support of workforce analytics.

name: Select workforce analysis methodology
desc: Consider stakeholder requirements, research questions, and organizations standards around research to select appropriate research methodology in support of workforce analytics.

name: Identify workforce data sources
desc: Identify appropriate data sources for workforce analytics data while considering organizational standards for data sources.

name: Gather workforce data
desc: Collect and procure, as needed, workforce data from internal and external data sources in support of workforce analytics.

name: Implement workforce analytics
desc: Transform, develop, and communicate workforce data into analytics in support of organizational requirements.

name: Transform workforce analysis data
desc: Logically and statistically validate collected or purchased data in support of analytics needs

name: Develop insights into workforce analytics outcomes
desc: Synthesize insights from workforce analytics data

name: Communicate workforce analysis outcomes
desc: Summarize, package, and distribute results of workforce analysis.

name: Manage employee communication
desc: Creating an effective plan that initiates and promotes communication and engagement among the employees and between employees and management.

name: Develop employee communication plan
desc: Creating a plan for managing communication among employees. Inform employees of direction. Counter resistance with change management approaches. Seek specific areas of input to the decision-making process. Seek varying degrees of involvement and co-creation.

name: Conduct employee engagement surveys
desc: Questioning employees to ascertain overall workplace satisfaction.

name: Deliver employee communications
desc: Implementing the communication plan for employees. Initiate dialogues and engagement by monitoring the exchange of ideas and opinions, the development of personal relationships, etc.

name: Manage Information Technology (IT)
desc: Managing process groups relevant to the business of information technology within an organization. The process groups include "Develop and manage IT customer relationships", "Develop and manage IT business strategy", " Develop and manage IT resilience and risk", " Manage information", " Develop and manage services/solutions", "Deploy services/solutions", and " Create and manage support services/solutions".
notes: DUAL USE: read every 8.x row twice - once as Sparkhound's internal IT, once as the service Sparkhound sells to clients. Tag which lens in Notes.

name: Develop and manage IT customer relationships
desc: Creating and administering relationships with IT customers. Understanding customer needs including high-level business requirements for IT transformation. Plan for and communicate IT services along with establishing IT service levels, providing transformation guidance, and performance analysis that foster IT customer relationships.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Understand IT customer needs
desc: Assessing the customer communities along with current IT operational capabilities and usage.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Understand IT customer communities
desc: Interacting with IT customers to understand the IT needs through a collaborative community through involvement, connection, and informed communication.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Assess IT customer operational capabilities
desc: Evaluate the ability of the group of staff dependent on information technology, to align resources and critical processes according to organizational vision being able to deliver effectively and efficiently.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Identify IT customer transformation needs
desc: Identifying changing needs of staff dependent on information technology based on continuous improvement to deliver results according to organizational goals. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI).
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Understand business requirements for IT capabilities
desc: Understanding business requirements for the existing IT environment as well as future IT needs.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Understand IT landscape
desc: Understanding the complete logical structure and working of the organization's IT landscape. Assess the configuration of hardware and software (IT Assets) across the organization that supports overall business operations.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Develop IT visioning
desc: Developing goals to define IT vision. Define and document ideas, direction, and activities which enable information technology to reach these goals.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Outline IT service expectations
desc: Defining a roadmap to meet organizational expectations from information technology services while considering how it will affect the business.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Plan and communicate IT services
desc: Create and design an organized and curated collection of all IT-related services that can be performed by, for, or within the organization. Maintain and convey information about deliverables, prices, contact points, and processes for requesting an information technology service.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Manage IT customer expectations
desc: Managing customer expectations of the existing IT environment while considering how it will affect the business.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Define future IT services
desc: Defining the expected demand and usage of information technology services to meet organization's future business goals. Gather necessary information about the processes, resource requirements, and structures pertaining to planned business growth.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Determine IT performance indicators
desc: Determining IT KPIs crucial to the organization's success. Measure indicators such as IT costs as percentage of revenue, IT maintenance ratio, and system downtime in an effort to evaluate the performance of IT across the organization.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Create IT marketing messages
desc: Developing concise statements that position the value proposition around the pressing concerns of the internal IT user base, thereby showing how the IT offerings are the right fit for a segment of IT customers.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Create IT service marketing plan
desc: Creating a marketing strategy for IT offerings to customers. Plan processes for making budgets; identifying and developing media; and managing marketing content and promotional activities.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Provide IT transformation guidance
desc: Understanding the necessity of IT transformation for the business. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI). Collect and analyze customer requirements. Identify opportunities and prioritize outcomes. Develop and support business case for transformation. Develop transformation plan and roadmap.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Develop IT transformation plans
desc: Developing a robust plan to replace or upgrade an organization's information technology systems. Understanding the business need of IT transformation from current to an expected state for the business. Developing a strategic plan for IT operating model, governance, service delivery, and workforce transformation.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Collect IT customer requirements
desc: Identifying existing or potential IT gaps between the expected business performance levels and current business outcomes.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Analyze IT customer requirements
desc: Assessing identified IT gaps to plan for remediation efforts to allow outcomes to meet established performance levels.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Identify and prioritize IT opportunities
desc: Identifying IT opportunities on the basis of collection and analysis of IT customer requirements, then prioritize the identified IT opportunities on the basis of their importance.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Facilitate solution design activities
desc: Providing a plan of action to provide solution to IT customers. The solution design should be based on the collection and analysis of IT customer requirements.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Prioritize IT outcomes
desc: Prioritizing IT outcomes based on need, effectiveness, and efficiency.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Develop business cases
desc: Create a business case with value proposition indicating current situation, proposed solution, financial analysis, and measurable benefits to the IT customers.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Support business case
desc: Supporting business case with supporting research, business analysis, and background information on IT transformation.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Develop transformation roadmap
desc: Creating a blueprint for execution of IT transformation from the existing state to the planned organizational structure based on the value proposition and projected business growth.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Develop and manage IT service levels
desc: Establishing and maintaining service levels for the provision of IT services and solutions. Design and maintain the IT services and solution catalogue, as well as service level agreements. Evaluate the performance of IT service level agreements. Communicate the results to the management.

name: Understand IT service requirements
desc: Understand requirements related to information technology services considering enterprise-level effects and understand potential achievements in the business environment.

name: Forecast IT service demand
desc: Forecasting demand for IT services using current business growth, research, and customer feedback. Refine these forecasts, inspect the approach used in creating forecasts, and determine its accuracy.

name: Maintain IT services catalog
desc: Maintain information about IT deliverables, prices, contact points, and processes for requesting a service.

name: Define service level agreement
desc: Designing and maintaining commitment of service by performance evaluation of IT services and communicate the results to the management.

name: Maintain IT customer contracts
desc: Maintaining and documenting commitment of service to staff for information technology contracts including providing software or hardware solution through communication channels like phone, email, and on-site services.

name: Negotiate and establish service level agreements
desc: Establish a service level agreement, which is a negotiated agreement designed to create a common understanding about services, priorities, and responsibilities.

name: Develop and maintain improvement processes
desc: Conveying the improvement opportunities for the business and level of IT services. Leverage the results obtained from the performance metrics of the business and IT service levels to identify and recognize any opportunities that would improve or enhance the efficiency of the business and IT service-level structure. Communicate these opportunities to management in order for the improvements to take effect.

name: Manage IT customer relationships
desc: Managing the IT relationship with its customers by systematically coordinating interactions over multiple touch points on a regular basis. Coordinate the IT's efforts to reach out to its customers, which include emails, social-media interactions, newsletters, and direct conversations.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Establish relationship management mechanisms
desc: Create mechanisms for effective public relationship in order to preserve the image and goodwill of the organization through the process.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Understand IT customer strategy
desc: Understanding the strategy for staff dependent on information technology. Create a plan to create services and solutions, conduct daily operations, and train new employees.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Understand IT customer environment
desc: Understanding the environment of staff dependent on information technology. Assess and evaluate services and solutions used by customers to conduct daily operations, and train new employees.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Communicate IT capabilities
desc: Conveying the goals and objectives of the IT function and how it contributes to the overall business objectives to staff and departments across the organization.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Manage IT requirements
desc: Managing the IT requirements for business objectives. Identify the requirements of hardware and software equipment to store, retrieve, transmit, and manipulate data related to business operations. Consider factors such as functional, design, growth phases, and delivery schedule while managing IT requirements.
notes: The vCIO / experience owner (EO) motion - QBRs, roadmaps, service reviews.

name: Analyze service performance
desc: Proactively manage IT service levels against IT customer requirements.
notes: Feeds the EO dashboard and client health scorecards.

name: Assess SLA compliance
desc: Gather data from each service target defined in an SLA for a time segment or review period to evaluate an overall performance percentage.
notes: Feeds the EO dashboard and client health scorecards.

name: Triage SLA compliance issues
desc: Prioritizing SLA compliance issues and plan for remediation.
notes: Feeds the EO dashboard and client health scorecards.

name: Collect feedback about IT products and services
desc: Collecting customer feedback about IT products and services effectiveness based on overall satisfaction. The data is collected through surveys, customer responses, and feedbacks based on the delivered products/services.
notes: Feeds the EO dashboard and client health scorecards.

name: Synthesize and distribute IT performance information
desc: Providing stakeholders with collected IT performance measures for further development based on evaluation.
notes: Feeds the EO dashboard and client health scorecards.

name: Develop and manage IT business strategy
desc: Handling the business of IT. Create a organization-wide strategy for the IT function. Define the organization's IT architecture. Manage the IT portfolio. Research and innovate in the field of IT. Assess and convey the performance and the value of the IT function.

name: Define business technology and governance strategy
desc: Defining the need of technology in business and systematic implementation of IT investments. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI). It comprises of assessing competitive technology components to ensure structural analysis, development, usage and security of technology for efficient business operations.

name: Build and maintain IT strategic intelligence
desc: Building and maintaining intelligence towards changing organizational goals, supporting management, and operational or functional levels of the business. It is the ability to understand business trends that present threats or opportunities for IT in an organization.

name: Monitor and map current and emerging technologies
desc: Monitoring and evaluating existing and forthcoming technologies to meet the current and future growth plans for business operations.

name: Define and communicate digital transformation strategy
desc: Defining the integration of digital technology into business operations and service delivery, and convey the strategy to different segments of business. It is always backed by continuous improvement followed by periodic review and change per requirement of the business.

name: Develop IT strategic alignment
desc: Developing the process of aligning the organization's business divisions and staff members with the organization's planned objectives for IT.

name: Articulate IT alignment principles
desc: Systematic approach to clearly communicate and operate the usage of information technology as it relates to business objectives.

name: Maintain IT strategic alignment
desc: Maintaining alignment of the organization's business divisions and staff members with the organization's planned objectives for IT.

name: Manage IT portfolio strategy
desc: Strategy for systematic management of IT investments, projects, and activities. Analyze and examine the value of the IT portfolio and allocate resources based on business objectives.

name: Establish and validate IT value criteria
desc: Create and certify the standards to determine the value of the investments, projects, and activities of IT function for the overall business objectives.

name: Determine IT portfolio investment balance
desc: Determining the uninvested amount out of the total approved amount for overall IT management, IT investments, projects, and activities.

name: Evaluate proposed IT investment projects
desc: Evaluating IT investment projects to achieve overall business objectives in regard to implementation, efficiency, and profitability.

name: Prioritize IT projects
desc: Listing the IT projects in the order of most important to the least. Determining which of many IT projects are most important or critical to business operations.

name: Align IT resources to strategic priorities
desc: Aligning physical IT resources like software, IT infrastructure, networks, and non-physical resources like technology expertise, to strategic objectives ranked by their importance in achieving the strategic goals.

name: Align IT portfolio to business objectives
desc: Aligning IT investments, projects, and activities to achieve overall business objectives.

name: Define and maintain enterprise architecture
desc: Outlining and maintaining the organization's IT architecture. Establish the IT architecture definition and framework. Ensure the relevance of IT. Create and confirm the approach for IT maintenance. Create rules and regulations to guide IT architecture. Authenticate and finalize all IT related research and innovation that takes place within the organization.

name: Create and publish enterprise architecture principles
desc: Creating and publishing high level statements of the fundamental values (principles) based on the organization's objectives that guide Information Technology decision-making and activities, and are the foundation for enterprise architecture.

name: Establish and operate enterprise architecture governance
desc: Establishing and operating a structure by which an enterprise defines appropriate strategies and ensures development alignment with those strategies. Create and establish the rules, regulations, policies, and standards that will govern the individual components of the IT architecture, as well as the architecture in its entirety.

name: Research technologies to innovate IT services and solutions
desc: Systematically investigating and studying materials and sources relevant to the IT function. Reach meaningful insights and conclusions in the form of new ideas and innovation for delivering IT services and solutions.

name: Provide input to definition and prioritization of IT projects
desc: Analyze the value driven through IT projects and redefine and/or reprioritize. Evaluate planning, organizing, and implementation of IT projects based on research outcomes and business objectives.

name: Define IT service management strategy
desc: Defining perspective, position, plans, and patterns needed to execute designing, delivering, managing, and improving the way information technology is used within an organization.

name: Establish IT service management strategy and goals
desc: Implementing strategy for designing, delivering, managing, and improving the way information technology be used in the organization. The goal of IT Service Management is to ensure that the right processes, people, and technology are in place to meet business goals.

name: Identify IT service operating and process requirements
desc: Identifying operating and process requirement for designing, delivering, managing, and improving the way information technology be used in the organization.

name: Define IT service catalog
desc: Create and design an organized and curated collection of all IT-related services that can be performed by, for, or within the organization.

name: Establish IT service management framework
desc: Create a layered structure for IT service management framework ensuring right processes, people, and technology are in place to meet business goals.

name: Define and implement IT service management
desc: Defining and implementing activities involved in designing, creating, delivering, supporting, and managing the lifecycle of information technology services within an organization.

name: Define and deploy support service management process tools and methods
desc: Establishing services for providing support to users of IT services and solutions. Define the plethora of services along with tools and methods by which the organization assists users of computers, software products, or other electronic/mechanical products.

name: Monitor and report IT performance
desc: Supervising, analyzing, and reporting performance of information technology to ensure they are on-course and on-schedule in meeting the organizational objectives and performance targets.

name: Control IT management system
desc: Regulating the IT management system through performance measures, governance, analysis, and monitoring through a variety of analytic tools. Evaluate IT finances, resource, services, projects, and value for report out.

name: Determine IT performance measures
desc: Determining measures for evaluating the performance of IT services in the organization. Establish key performance indicators, including the IT services performance index.

name: Define IT control points and assurance procedures governance model
desc: Establishing a governance model with its own structure and functions from where full or partial control can be exercised over the entire IT management system. Specify evaluation and quality control procedures in the structure.

name: Monitor and analyze overall IT performance
desc: Monitoring and analyzing information technology performance measures to ensure timely completion, and that quality assurance is met at all steps of IT services.

name: Monitor and analyze IT financial performance
desc: Checking and analyzing predetermined financial targets and timelines of IT management system. Monitoring their profitability, feasibility, and consistency. Study the revenues generated.

name: Monitor and analyze IT value and benefits
desc: Examining and analyzing the value and benefits of IT service management to ensure benefits outweigh incurred costs.

name: Optimize IT resource allocation
desc: Create process to assign and manage IT assets that support organization's strategic goals.

name: Manage IT projects and services interdependencies
desc: Manage capabilities required for the successful delivery of information technology projects, which, by extension, affect the success of the overall IT services.

name: Report IT service and project performance
desc: Process of collecting, analyzing, and reporting information regarding the performance of IT services and projects.

name: Select, deploy, and operate IT performance analytics tools
desc: Select, establish, and operate analytics tool to analyze data and extract actionable and commercially relevant information on IT performance to evaluate or increase performance.

name: Manage IT value portfolio
desc: Creating and establishing the value portfolio. Defining, analyzing, and examining the value of projects, investments, and activities of the IT function.

name: Assess performance against IT service and project value criteria
desc: Process of evaluating performance to collect and analyze IT services and projects. Ensure expected IT service and project value based on established criteria.

name: Quantify value of IT service and project portfolio investments
desc: Evaluate the value of the investments, projects, and activities of IT function by assigning it a quantifiable value with a profitable return to business operations.

name: Communicate business technology value contribution
desc: Conveying the value addition through adopting technology targeting towards integrated profitable business operations.

name: Determine and implement IT portfolio adjustments
desc: Determining and implementing IT investments, projects, and activities based on trending technological advancements in the existing environment in order to achieve overall business objectives.

name: Define and manage technology innovation
desc: Outline and manage the innovation of technology within the organization. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI). Research and understand emerging future technological concepts and capabilities. Plan for IT innovation investments. Plan and execute viable innovation projects.

name: Establish selection criteria for research initiatives
desc: Establishing the standard for selecting IT research initiatives to align with organizational criteria for implementing future technologies.

name: Analyze emerging technology concepts
desc: Assessing new and future technologies relevant to the organization's vision of its IT capabilities.

name: Identify technology concepts and capabilities
desc: Identification of conceptual elements that define the benefits of technology to business.

name: Execute IT research projects
desc: Implement information technology research projects that focus on meeting the goals of the organization's IT services and capabilities.

name: Evaluate IT research project outcomes
desc: Assessing IT research projects based on defined outcome expectations.

name: Identify and promote viable concepts
desc: Determine project viability. Promote relevant IT innovations that meet business objectives.

name: Develop and plan IT investment projects
desc: Develop and plan long-term allocation of funds for information technology endeavors to meet business goals.

name: Develop and manage IT resilience and risk
desc: Develop and include the processes required to rapidly adapt and respond to any internal or external opportunity, demand, disruption, or threat to IT and cybersecurity. Build a dynamic, strategic, and integrated approach to managing IT and cyber risks, compliance obligations, and resilience, while ensuring alignment with global standards and frameworks.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Develop IT compliance, risk, and security strategy
desc: Ensuring that the organization effectively manages IT and cybersecurity risks by developing rules, standards, and strategies that safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of IT and OT assets. Establish compliance objectives, align with recognized cybersecurity frameworks, and integrate IT and OT risk management to create a unified approach.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Determine and evaluate IT regulatory and audit requirements
desc: Determining and evaluating IT regulatory and audit requirements. Train employees on regulatory and audit requirements. Records for the appropriate regulatory and audit agencies must be maintained and the new product process must be approved by the appropriate regulatory body before it is published to the organization.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Understand business unit risk tolerance
desc: Understand the risk tolerance levels of individual business units, given risk-return trade-offs for one or more anticipated and predictable consequences.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Establish IT risk tolerance
desc: Determine the specific maximum risk to take in quantitative terms for each relevant risk sub-category, including strategic, operational, financial, and compliance risks.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Establish risk ownership
desc: Establish an individual or a group who is ultimately accountable for ensuring that IT risks are managed appropriately.

desc: Identifying and supervising a blueprint of measures for managing risk in IT. Monitor actions to enhance opportunities and reduce threats to project objectives.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

desc: Planning and managing the organization’s ability to recover from exposure to internal and external threats, with a focus on IT and cybersecurity. notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

desc: Creating and deploying an architecture for securing and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Develop and implement protocols and policies to protect IT and OT environments, aligned with global standards. Incorporate modern security paradigms, such as Zero Trust Architecture, to ensure the safe use of IT services and solutions.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Assess IT regulatory and confidentiality requirements and policies
desc: Evaluate principles or rules employed in controlling, directing, or managing IT services. Assessing requirements and policies related to confidentiality.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Create IT security, privacy, and data protection risk governance
desc: Defining and managing organization's approach to governing IT security and ensuring the privacy of data flows throughout the organization. Establish and manage tools to support the governance process in order to avoid misuse of information and breach of organizational privacy.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Define IT data security and privacy policies, standards, and procedures

notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Review and monitor application security controls
desc: Identifying, examining, and reviewing security control for IT applications. Test, analyze, and implement security protocols in order to safeguard IT applications.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Review and monitor IT physical environment security controls
desc: Identifying and examining security controls for physical environment of information technology such as business facilities, equipment, and resources.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Monitor/analyze network intrusion detection data and resolve threats
desc: Monitoring and evaluating network intrusion detection for any malicious activity or policy violations. Identify the gaps in order to resolve threats and enhance existing network security.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Scan for and prioritize vulnerabilities
desc: Scan internal and internet-facing assets continuously and rate findings by CVSS, weighted for internet exposure and active exploits.

name: Deploy patches
desc: Patch operating systems and third-party applications monthly through NinjaOne in maintenance windows, piloting first where feasible; patch critical and actively exploited vulnerabilities out of cycle as soon as a validated patch exists.

name: Track remediation against targets and approve exceptions
desc: Track remediation against the targets (Critical within days, 24 to 48 hours if exploited or internet-facing; High 30 days; Medium 90 days; Low routine) and approve time-bound exceptions with compensating controls.

name: Enforce encryption standards
desc: AES-256 on every laptop and desktop before issue, MDM with encryption on mobile devices, TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest for sensitive data and backups; exceptions need documented approval and a compensating control.

name: Respond to lost or stolen devices
desc: A lost or stolen device is reported and acted on within 24 hours.

name: Conduct and analyze IT compliance assessments
desc: Evaluate and analyze the IT environment for the compliance of industry regulations and government legislation. Ensure that IT capability and resources meet the set standards.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Conduct projects to enhance IT compliance and remediate risk
desc: Conducting projects in order to enhance set standards, established guidelines, and risk preventive measures for IT risk and resilience.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Conduct IT compliance control auditing of internal and external services
desc: Examine compliance control systems and tools implemented for internal and external IT services.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Perform IT compliance reporting
desc: Execute IT compliance reporting in order to review processes, standards, regulations, and laws are followed as laid out by the regulatory bodies.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Identify and escalate IT compliance issues and remediation requirements
desc: Identify and escalate issues related to IT compliance to ensure that corrective measures are taken.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Support external audits and reports
desc: Supporting audits and reports through external resources. This process requires the organization to follow all the regulations set forth by external auditors.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Develop and execute IT resilience and continuity operations
desc: Create and execute a process to rapidly adapt and respond to any internal or external opportunity, demand, disruption, or threat in IT. Maintain continuous IT operations to protect employees, assets, and overall brand equity.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Conduct IT resilience improvement projects
desc: Conducting projects to improve the strategy and process for rapidly adapting to any threat in IT.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Develop, document, and maintain IT business continuity planning
desc: Develop, document, and maintain plans to ensure uninterrupted operations of critical IT services (for example, ransomware recovery). Determine resources such as specialized personnel, equipment, support infrastructure, third-party access, legal and financial aspects.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Implement and enforce change control procedures
desc: Implement and enforce procedures and policies in order to control changes in IT services and solutions. Manage changes in a rational and predictable manner for optimum resource utilization.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Execute recurring IT service provider business continuity
desc: Review and implement resources (including external parties) necessary to support uninterrupted operations of critical IT services.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Provide IT resilience training
desc: Conduct and manage employee training programs on IT resilience so that prospective risks can be avoided.
sup: HaloPSA (compliance area), ComplianceScorecard, Arctic Wolf Managed Awareness
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Execute recurring IT business operations continuity
desc: Implement regular resources supporting uninterrupted operations of critical IT services.
notes: Highest compliance leverage in the framework. Maps to the Halo GRC ticket area.

name: Manage IT user identity and authorization
desc: The process of identifying, authenticating, and authorizing IT users to have access to applications, systems, IT components, or networks by associating user rights and restrictions with established identities.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Support integration of identity and authorization policies
desc: Create and implement policies that integrate authorization policies with authorized profiles of users meant to access network resources.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Manage IT user directory
desc: Managing directory of user profiles and access requirements across different levels in the organization's IT network.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Manage IT user authorization
desc: Managing the process of authorizing IT users to access applications, systems, IT components, or networks by associating user rights.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Manage IT user authentication mechanisms
desc: Create and manage the process to authenticate IT users from user directory based on the internal policies.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA)
desc: Adopting MFA to ensure secure user authentication across all systems.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Implement identity federation and single sign-on (SSO)
desc: Integrating identity federation and SSO solutions to enhance user experience and security.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Audit IT user identity and authorization systems
desc: Examine the processes responsible for reviewing IT user identity and authorization.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Respond to IT information security and network breaches
desc: Address any form of unauthorized network breach such as unauthorized access or usage of data, applications, services, networks, and/or devices. Identify the root cause and take corrective measures to resolve the breach.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Report and triage suspected security incidents
desc: Anyone who suspects an incident reports it immediately, without investigating first, through the 24/7 monitored channel. The report is triaged, given a severity, and evidence preservation starts before containment.

name: Contain the incident and preserve evidence
desc: Isolate affected systems and preserve logs, forensic images and system state under chain of custody.

name: Notify the cyber liability carrier before eradication
desc: Mandatory checkpoint: the carrier is notified, and carrier-approved forensic and legal resources engaged, before any eradication work changes evidence or system state.

name: Eradicate the threat and recover systems
desc: Remove the threat, close the exploited weakness, restore systems, and monitor closely for recurrence.

name: Determine breach notification obligations
desc: Legal counsel and compliance decide whether a breach must be notified, to whom, and on what timeline, from the data involved, the applicable law (state law, HIPAA, GDPR, DFARS) and client contracts.

name: Notify affected clients, individuals and regulators
desc: Notify without undue delay once a breach is confirmed, within the client agreement and statutory timelines, with a single coordinated account when a vendor is involved, and give clients the facts they need for their own obligations.

name: Conduct post-incident reviews
desc: After every incident: document root cause, assign and track corrective actions, update procedures. Incident records are kept at least six years.

name: Exercise the incident response program
desc: Run a tabletop exercise at least annually and verify the escalation contact directory quarterly.

name: Conduct penetration testing
desc: Conduct penetration testing (pen test) through an authorized stimulated attack to identify security weakness in an IT environment by evaluating the system or network with various harmful techniques.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

name: Audit integration of user identity and authorization systems
desc: Reviewing the processes responsible for integration of user identity and access authorization in order to confirm that all the required regulations are followed.
notes: Joiner-mover-leaver; pairs with 7.6 separation.

notes: Professional Services application and solution development.

name: Assess and validate IT service/solution requirements
desc: Evaluating and validating the requirements and needs of IT service/solution.
notes: Professional Services application and solution development.

name: Create service/solution design
desc: Formulating a design for service/solution that helps an organization to meet its objectives. Develop a new framework for molding the service/solution processes into a coherent and structured form.

name: Create implementation communications
desc: Coordinating change implementation in IT services and solutions communications with employees and stakeholders.

name: Manage IT roll-back procedures
desc: Managing procedures to return to initial pre-deployment stage or previous state from current environment.

name: Manage change deployment control
desc: Creating and deploying an architecture for securing the changes deployed in the organization. Create and develop protocols that ensure proper and efficient use of deployed IT services and solutions. Test, evaluate, and implement the policies and protocols.
owner: Internal Change Board / Client Change Board

name: Asses IT change/release impact
desc: Evaluating the impact of IT change/release on the business.

name: Confirm change/release compliance
desc: Ensure that change/release meets change guidelines set by the organization.

name: Assess IT change/release risk
desc: Evaluating for any kind of risks or threats which could be caused due to IT change/release deployment.

name: Consolidate IT change
desc: Integrate all forms of changes in IT in order to make more efficient use of resources and down time, and optimizing results.

name: Create and communicate deployment schedule
desc: Defining and communicating the schedule for implementation to related stakeholders and functions.

name: Approve change/release deployment
desc: Permitting for the change/release deployment. Approve deployment based on the evaluation of business impact due to change/release.

name: Document IT change/release outcome
desc: Recording outcomes related to the change/release deployment.

name: Submit and review change requests at the Change Board
owner: Requestor; Internal or Client Change Board
desc: Normal changes need a complete change request (type, people, dates, description, justification, impact, test, back-out and communication plans) reviewed by the Internal Change Board (Sparkhound systems) or Client Change Board (client production) and approved by majority vote with quorum.

name: Maintain pre-approved standard changes
desc: The Boards approve the procedures for low-risk, repeatable standard changes, which are then logged without an individual vote.

name: Approve and ratify emergency changes
desc: One voting member signs off an emergency change; elevated access is time-limited and logged; the full Board ratifies within two business days.

name: Validate implemented changes and roll back failures
desc: Confirm the change worked and introduced no vulnerability or outage; follow the back-out plan if it did; update baselines when a change becomes a standard.

name: Review change logs quarterly
desc: Quarterly review of change records for completeness and adherence; records kept at least one year, longer where a client contract requires.

name: Implement technology solutions
desc: Deploy the identified solutions for information technology important for healthy business operations. Confirm status and operational availability of IT resources. Perform testing and distribution of change. Execute roll-back protocol if necessary.

name: Confirm hardware/software operational status
desc: Confirm if hardware/software are operating as per the expectation.

name: Confirm operational availability
desc: Confirm if operational activities of IT services could be performed.

name: Execute internal IT implementation plan
desc: Executing IT implementation plan to make the IT services and solutions available for internal use.

name: Confirm implementation completion
desc: Confirming the completion of IT implementation.

name: Implement software change/release
desc: Executing changes in software and services as per change/release schedule.

name: Perform post-installation testing
desc: Perform testing after installation to confirm expected performance is met.

name: Distribute software components network-wide
desc: Distributing and implementing the release of changed IT solutions. Administer, implement, and install the releases onto internal systems. Provide methods for installing releases on client users.

name: Verify change/release implementation success
desc: Confirming that the release has met expectations.

name: Execute roll-back plan
desc: Execution of plan to return to the previous operating state if the change/release impedes operational expectations.

name: Perform service and solution rollout
desc: Strategizing and executing changes in IT solutions and services. Create a plan for deploying the changes. Communicate with stakeholders about the changes. Administer and implement the changes. Train the resources who will be affected by these changes. Install changes and verify their effect.

name: Conduct IT training
desc: Preparing users for changes in IT solutions. Conduct training sessions and engagement activities to familiarize users with the new changes. Implementing the programs for training IT employees.

name: Prepare and distribute service/solution communications
desc: Coordinating communications regarding the changes in IT services and solutions with employees in the organization.

name: Support organizational changes
desc: Creating a strategy for providing support for organizational changes. Providing support to users of IT services and solutions.

name: Execute rollout plans
desc: Executing a plan for introducing the IT services and solutions to the organization's end user base.

name: Provide rollout support
desc: Establishing services for providing support to users of IT services and solutions for rollout. Define the plethora of services by which the organization assists users of technology products.

name: Manage rollout support capabilities
desc: Managing the necessary skills and competencies required to efficiently provide IT resolution for rollout through the support structure. Identify the gaps and needs in support structure.

name: Monitor and record rollout issues
desc: Track and record any issues being faced due to rollout. Define methodology of assessment for measuring and monitoring issues.

name: Create and manage support services/solutions
desc: Establishing and managing services for providing support to users of IT services and solutions. Define the plethora of services by which the organization assists users of computers, software products, or other information technology products.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Define and establish service delivery strategy
desc: Defining and establishing strategy for delivering IT services and solutions to the users. Design an IT service delivery model that defines the processes and procedures needed to deliver the IT services and solutions.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Assess business objectives and IT service delivery
desc: Assessing the goals and objectives of IT service delivery and how it contributes to the overall business objectives. Align with the business objectives of the organization.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Define IT service delivery portfolio
desc: Creating and establishing a repository of IT service delivery offerings.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Create and maintain IT service delivery model
desc: Design and maintaining an IT service delivery model that defines the processes and procedures needed to deliver the IT services and solutions.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Determine IT service delivery locations and activities
desc: Determining locations and types of IT services and solutions which need to be delivered.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Define IT service delivery sourcing strategy
desc: Defining a strategy for sourcing delivery of IT services and solutions. Examine the pros and cons of various sources that can support the delivery process. Select the most feasible and cost-effective sources.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Define and develop service support strategy
desc: Defining and creating a strategy for provision of support to users of IT services and solutions.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Assess business objectives and IT service support delivery
desc: Assessing the goals of IT service support delivery and how it aligns to contribute to the overall business objectives.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Define IT service support portfolio
desc: Defining different IT support services and solutions such as remote support and cloud support. Include planned IT initiatives and ongoing IT services (such as application support).
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Create and maintain IT support model
desc: Design and maintaining an IT support model that defines the processes and procedures needed to support users of IT services and solutions.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Develop IT support service sourcing strategy
desc: Developing a strategy for sourcing resources to support users of IT services and solutions. Establish sources that will make use of e-mail, live support software online, or a tool where users can log a call or incident in order to retrieve IT support.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Establish support service framework
desc: Creating an agenda for the rules and regulations of support service that deal with providing support to users of IT services and solutions.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Provide service support tools and technology
desc: Providing the tools and techniques to support users of IT services and solutions, and choosing the most appropriate tools and techniques. Evaluate the pros and cons of all the methodologies and tools available. Choose the most efficient and effective methodology.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Plan and manage service delivery control
desc: Determine and manage service delivery flow across different business functions. Understand the level of services needed by different stakeholders. Identify major service delivery touch points and criticality associated. Ensure timely communication with users.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Plan operational activities for IT service delivery
desc: Planning different delivery services for operational activities within the IT function. Use service delivery systems to manage the IT service delivery services.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Schedule service delivery resources
desc: Scheduling resources to provide service delivery to IT users. Ensure design, development, deployment, and operations are aligned with the business objectives.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Maintain/optimize batch job schedule
desc: Maintaining and scheduling batch jobs to run in the background at a certain date and time.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Schedule change/release windows
desc: Determine the timely change or release of IT services or support. Assign periodic release/change to IT systems or services.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Schedule/optimize backup and archive activities
desc: Schedule or optimize backup and archive activities for IT services and solutions. Use a backup system or application and archive operations data for future retrieval.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Balance operational workloads across available infrastructure components
desc: Balancing workloads of all the processes and services that are provisioned to their internal or external clients, across available components of IT infrastructure. No component should be over or under utilized with the workflow of the IT operations.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Determine specific problem support procedures
desc: Determining process and procedure to provide support for specific IT service problems.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Develop and manage infrastructure resource planning
desc: Developing and managing the resources required for administration of infrastructure. Manage the IT inventory and assets to meet organization's IT resource capacity.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Develop IT service delivery strategy
desc: Creating a strategy for delivering IT services and solutions. Establish the sourcing strategy. Establish the delivery process procedures and tools. Examine and choose the most effective methodologies and tools.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Assess IT infrastructure business objectives
desc: Assessing the goals and objectives of IT infrastructure and how it contributes to the overall business objectives.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Determine ongoing IT infrastructure capabilities
desc: Determining existing IT infrastructure capabilities. Identify the gaps and needs in order to enhance the existing IT infrastructure to meet growth objectives.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Plan IT infrastructure change
desc: Identify the gaps and needs of existing IT infrastructure. Plan and develop strategies to upgrade/replace existing IT infrastructure.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Plan and budget IT license usage volumes
desc: Creating a plan associated with usage volumes of IT licenses. Develop a framework to govern the licensing of an IT services along with identified usage volumes. Determine the amount of investment in IT license usage volumes and how would the license volumes be financed.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Define service support planning
desc: Develop strategies and methodologies to provide service support. Examine service levels, support complexity, stakeholder requirements to offer service support.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Understand IT support demand patterns
desc: Evaluate criticality catered by the IT support and expectations to resolve raised or identified issues. Determine the usual requests received for IT support for each area of IT operations. Ensure resolution to every identified or reported issue within specified SLAs.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Determine required support resource levels, responsibilities, and capabilities
desc: Determining levels of required support resources along with their responsibilities, and capabilities to resolve IT issues. Evaluate and ensure that support resources are fulfilling their responsibilities n a timely manner.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Maintain service support knowledge repository
desc: Create and maintain service support knowledge repository. Store, maintain, access, revise, and use knowledge for IT services. Review knowledge trends and implement knowledge transfer methodologies for competitive advantage.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Maintain service support learning
desc: Maintaining and transfer of knowledge towards service support with the change/upgrade in technology over a stipulated period. Ensure IT staff is well trained and tested on the new learning of service support.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Communicate service support needs
desc: Conveying service support needs within the organization, with the objective of providing required support services. Define processes and procedures needed to support users of IT services and solutions. Convey these procedures to appropriate governing authority.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Define IT escalation mechanisms
desc: Determining mechanisms to report for a higher degree of decision making depending on the criticality of IT escalations. Define the processes and procedures needed to follow for IT escalation at different levels. Convey the mechanisms within the organization.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Manage IT service support resources
desc: Managing resources required for administration of IT service support. Establish sources that will make use of e-mail, live support software online, or a tool where users can log a call or incident in order to retrieve IT support.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Coordinate with external support providers
desc: Developing a strategy that will make use of multiple resources to coordinate with external support providers in order to make the support services work more smoother.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Triage IT service delivery incidents
desc: Sorting the incidents of IT service delivery in certain order so that the services could be delivered based on the criticality.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Monitor IT service support performance
desc: Defining methodology and frequency of assessment for measuring and monitoring performance of various processes and activities of IT service support against standard set goals.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Develop and manage service delivery operations
desc: Developing and managing different delivery services using service delivery systems for operational activities within the IT function in order to achieve organizations goal.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Operate and monitor online systems
desc: Operating and defining methodology of assessment for measuring and monitoring performance of online systems against its expected result.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Run and monitor batch job schedule
desc: Operate and monitor the application of scheduling batch jobs to be run in the background at a certain date and time.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Manage service delivery workloads
desc: Analyze and manage workload needs in relation to service delivery. Plan resources and mechanism around those workload needs so that services could be delivered smoothly.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Manage infrastructure performance and capacity
desc: Managing the performance and capacity of infrastructure by using key performance indicators to routinely track the performance and capacity levels. Review performance. Evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of the infrastructure.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Respond to unplanned operational issues
desc: Addressing to an issue in operational activities within the IT function, that occur outside of normal routine or preventative maintenance.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Produce and distribute output media
desc: Identify and introduce resources to display output in a viewable form to key decision makers and evaluators.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Monitor IT infrastructure security
desc: Identifying, examining, and recognizing any flaw or breach in security of IT infrastructure. Ensure that protocols and guidelines for individual IT components are being followed and there is no misuse of information and breach of individual or organizational privacy.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Manage IT infrastructure/data recovery
desc: Managing resources of IT infrastructure and their recovery capacity. Manage storage, computer hardware, software, and infrastructure resources that can be stored as inventory or provided by the organization as needed. Managing backup/recovery for IT services and solutions. Use a backup system or application.
owner: Director of Managed Services; DR Coordinator
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan

name: Monitor backup jobs and investigate failures
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: Independent, encrypted, immutable backups of Sparkhound SaaS data run on a 24-hour cycle; failed jobs are investigated within one business day. Retention is 90 days point-in-time plus 12 monthly archives.

name: Test restores quarterly
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: Restore a sample of mailboxes, files, sites and service management records to a test location each quarter and record completeness and restore time.

name: Restore systems in recovery-tier order
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: Restore Tier 0 (identity, email, service management; RTO 4h) first, then Tier 1 (finance, documents, RMM; 24h), Tier 2 (CRM, e-signature, marketing; 72h) and Tier 3 (120h), validating integrity before return to use.

name: Manage infrastructure resource administration
desc: Managing the resources required for administration of IT infrastructure. Manage the IT inventory and assets. Take care of the organization's IT resource capacity.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Manage infrastructure configuration
desc: Identifying and tracking individual configuration items, documenting functional capabilities and interdependencies of IT infrastructure. Determining the gaps and needs in order to enhance existing infrastructure configuration.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Perform infrastructure component maintenance
desc: Evaluating and maintaining all aspects of infrastructure component maintenance. Ensure that all components of an IT infrastructure are functioning properly as per the expectation. Maintenance includes all preventative, routine, and corrective measures.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Install/configure/upgrade infrastructure components
desc: Installing/configuring/upgrading all the components required for operational activities within IT infrastructure. Ensure that all components of an IT infrastructure are functioning properly and updated to latest version/technology.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Maintain IT asset records
desc: Maintaining the complete list of IT items or resources available with the organization with the details on date of purchase, licenses, deployment and SLAs.
notes: The managed services engine - NOC, service desk, infrastructure operations.

name: Administer IT licenses/user agreements
