desc: Managing locations where end-of-life assets are evaluated for decommissioning, disassembly, recycling, etc.

name: Dismantle assets
desc: Dismantling an asset into manageable parts. The parts may follow different dispositions, such as resale, reuse, recycle, etc.

name: Track parts
desc: Tracking the disposition of all parts from end-of-life assets. Tracking should provide an audit trail to include source, rational for disposition, and destination.

name: Recycle parts
desc: Recycling parts in accordance with legal, regulatory, and social/environmental responsibilities.

name: Ship hazardous material
desc: Planning, conducting, and tracking shipment of hazardous materials.

name: Provide government reporting
desc: Preparing and distributing government reports.

name: Perform abandonment
desc: Planning and performing abandonment activities. Whether facilities  or equipment, ensure assets to be abandoned are safe, secure, and meet all legal, regulatory, and social/environmental responsibilities.

name: Demolish and secure
desc: Demolishing and securing asset and resulting parts/debris.

name: Restore site
desc: Performing remediation or restoration activities.

name: Monitor site for duration of time required by regulators
desc: Managing and reporting site status. Align efforts to all legal, regulatory and social/environmental responsibilities.

name: Prepare handover to new operator or landowner
desc: Supporting handover to new operator or landowner. Include proper documentation on asset history and current state to enable orderly transition.

name: Perform waste and hazardous goods management
desc: Planning and performing waste and hazardous goods management. In compliance with all legal, regulatory, and social/environmental requirements, plan, document, and conduct hazardous material handling, disposal, and reporting.

name: Maintain material safety data sheets
desc: Preparing material safety sheets. Capture material safety records to properly apply handling and disposal requirements.

name: Maintain awareness of and communicate regulatory requirements
desc: Understanding and communicating hazardous material regulatory requirements.

name: Maintain hazardous material handling and disposal
desc: Planning, overseeing, and tracking hazardous material handling and disposal.

name: Manage compliance audits
desc: Planning, supporting, and documenting hazardous material audits.

name: Recognize need to disposition hazardous materials/waste
desc: Identifying and establishing approaches to dispose of hazardous materials/waste.

name: Determine disposition and associated processing
desc: Evaluating hazardous materials and waste for appropriate disposition. Apply requirements and initiate disposition activities.

name: Manage disposition, disposal, reprocessing activities
desc: Performing disposition, disposal, and reprocessing activities.

name: Manage documentation and reporting
desc: Documenting and reporting disposition, disposal, and reprocessing activities.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
desc: Ensuring that an organization effectively manages its risk. Process groups are aligned with traditional risk management activities.
notes: Both an internal obligation and a sellable capability.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage enterprise risk
desc: Creating requisite frameworks and coordinating all risk management activities for the entire organization and each function. Manage the enterprise risk by outlining the risk policies and procedures. Monitor and communicate all risk management activities. Encourage correspondence among the business units. Manage the risk of all business units and functions.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Establish the enterprise risk framework and policies
desc: Creating an agenda for the rules and regulations of enterprise risk that deal with hazardous, financial, operational, and strategic risks. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI).

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Determine risk tolerance for organization
desc: Recognizing the organization's tolerance for risk, given risk-return trade-offs for one or more anticipated and predictable consequences.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Develop and maintain enterprise risk policies and procedures
desc: Establishing and maintaining the policies and procedures for managing risk. Create rules and regulations for enterprise risk dealing with hazardous, financial, operational, and strategic risks.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Identify and implement enterprise risk management tools
desc: Recognizing and implementing tools for managing risk. Identify and apply enterprise risk management tools. Leverage methods and processes to manage risks and opportunities associated with business objectives.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Coordinate the sharing of risk knowledge across the organization
desc: Communicating the knowledge about risk within the organization. Identify operational risks. Share risk information within the organization.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Prepare and report enterprise risk to executive management and board
desc: Preparing and presenting reports about enterprise risk to the management of the organization. Create reports for management on hazard risks (e.g., property damage and liability torts), financial risks (e.g., currency and liquidity risks), and operational risks (e.g., product failure, customer satisfaction, social trends, and competition).

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Oversee and coordinate enterprise risk management activities
desc: Coordinating to plan, organize, lead, and control the activities of an organization in order to minimize the special effects of risk on capital and earnings.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Identify enterprise level risks
desc: Determining risks that could thwart objectives, including crises that may impact customer service such as data breaches or significant product issues. Document and communicate the concern.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Assess risks to determine which to mitigate
desc: Identifying options/actions to enhance opportunities and reduce threats. Recognize the root reasons of the identified risks.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Develop risk mitigation and management strategy and integrate with existing performance management processes
desc: Developing activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats. Specify the organization's objectives. Evolve strategies and policies to attain these objectives. Assign resources to project objectives.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Verify business unit and functional risk mitigation plans are implemented
desc: Checking that the blueprint created for managing risk in individual business units and divisions is correctly effectuated. Validate the implementation of all activities geared to mitigate risks.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Ensure risks and risk mitigation actions are monitored
desc: Ensuring risk monitoring and mitigation activities. Monitor actions to enhance opportunities and reduce threats to project objectives.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Report on enterprise risk activities
desc: Creating a report of activities to address hazard risks, liability torts, financial risks, operational risks, social trends, competition, etc.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Coordinate business unit and functional risk management activities
desc: Coordinating risk management activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats. Specify the organization's objectives. Assign resources to project objectives.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Ensure that each business unit/function follows the enterprise risk management process
desc: Checking each business unit's/function's options and activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Ensure that each business unit/function follows the enterprise risk reporting process
desc: Checking the reporting process of each business unit's/function's options and activities to improve opportunities and lessen threats.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage business unit and function risk
desc: Analyzing the threats a business unit/function faces to prioritize the controls it implements..

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Identify risks
desc: Developing a timely and continuous process to identify activities that might hinder a project's goals.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Assess risks using enterprise risk framework policies and procedures
desc: Determining the possibility that a specified undesirable event will occur using established tools, implements, and frameworks. Use risk assessments to determine, for example, whether to undertake a particular venture, what rate of return a particular investment requires, and how to mitigate an activity's potential losses.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Develop mitigation plans for risks
desc: Developing possibilities and arrangements to improve opportunities and reduce deviations to project objectives.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Assess adequacy of insurance coverage
desc: Evaluating the changing needs for insurance coverage. Research available insurance providers and offerings.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Implement mitigation plans for risks
desc: Executing mitigation plans to improve opportunities and reduce deviations to project objectives.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Monitor risks
desc: Identifying, examining, and recognizing/justifying any improbability in investment decision making.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Analyze risk activities and update plans
desc: Examining the impact of risk activities in order to update the existing scheme of risk management. Analyze and substantiate the potential for adverse consequences to occur. Consider the risks associated with the activity and the methods available to manage those risks.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Report on risk activities
desc: Creating reports on risk activities, and communicating them to management. Prepare reports on the potential for adverse safety consequences.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage compliance
desc: Managing steps to confirm enduring compliance to industry regulations and government legislation.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Establish compliance framework and policies
desc: Developing a set of procedures detailing an organization's progress in complying with established guidelines, provisions, and legislation.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Develop enterprise compliance policies and procedures
desc: Creating a standardized approach to ethics and compliance. Have a programmatic approach for compliance that focuses on the definite risks the organization faces.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Implement enterprise compliance activities
desc: Implementing standardized for ethics and compliance. Have a programmatic approach, built from the top down, to enterprise compliance that focuses on the definite risks the organization faces.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage internal audits
desc: Managing accounts and prepare regular reports on financial performance.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Maintain controls-related technologies and tools
desc: Managing technologies and tools related to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data in order to ensure the security of the organization's information. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI).
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage regulatory compliance
desc: Obeying laws, guidelines, strategies, and stipulations related to the business.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Develop regulatory compliance procedures
desc: Developing procedures and methodologies to comply with relevant laws and regulations of an organization's obedience to laws, guidelines, strategies and stipulations related to business.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Identify applicable regulatory requirements
desc: Determining the regulatory requirements that are most appropriate for the organization. Identify goals in order to follow the appropriate rules and regulations, guidelines, and strategies.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Monitor the regulatory environment for changing or emerging regulations
desc: Analyzing and overseeing the regulatory environment in order to spot any changing or emerging regulations. This process element calls upon the organization to monitor the regulatory environment for any new statutes, policies, and enactments issued by the respective government authorities or those which have been updated.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Assess current compliance position and identify weaknesses or shortfalls therein
desc: Evaluating current regulatory policies and regulations. Assess their performance. Make necessary changes.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Implement missing or stronger regulatory compliance controls and policies
desc: Assessing the current policies and policies. Implement missing and necessary changes environmental changes, political changes, technological changes, etc.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Monitor and test regulatory compliance position and existing controls
desc: Monitoring, appraising, and evaluating the compliance position of the organization in order to fine-tune for effective remediation. Track efforts for handling regulatory and compliance requirements necessitated by law. Test the robustness of internal frameworks, procedures, and approaches for dealing with these requirements, in order to clearly identify any necessary changes.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Compile and communicate compliance scorecard(s)
desc: Creating a graphical representation of metrics in order to communicate the general health of the organization in relation to risk and compliancy.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Compile and communicate internal and regulatory compliance reports
desc: Submitting compliance reports to regulatory agencies. These reports can be made to environmental, securities, or human resources agencies as stipulated by the local governing body.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Maintain relationships with regulators as appropriate
desc: Developing and preserving relationships with the regulators, without compromising the legal basis of the relationship.
notes: Isolated from SLA metrics per the Halo GRC build-out.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage remediation efforts
desc: Administering the efforts and activities for remediation. This process element requires the organization to create plans for corrective action in collaboration with government agencies and pertinent professional services agencies which specialize in remediation efforts relevant to the organization's operations. Additionally, the organization needs to consult experts to validate the plan, determine resources allocation, resolve any legal concerns, and formulate a company-wide policy for remediation.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Create remediation plans
desc: Creating plans for remediation efforts. Make a plan to address a case of environmental adulteration. Identify and treat the adulteration so that the area will become operational again.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Contact and confer with experts
desc: Discussing and soliciting advice from experts for in order to incorporate their suggestion (regarding Create remediation plans [11201]).

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Identify/Dedicate resources
desc: Identifying and dedicating the resources for managing remediation efforts. Discern the resources needed for remediation efforts. Dispense with resources in a sound and well-reasoned manner.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Investigate legal aspects
desc: Examining regulatory and legislative frameworks. Obligate the organization to remediate any damages through compensations, fines, and any other remedial efforts necessitated to correct the situations. Analyze local environmental laws, binding international covenants, etc. in order to examine legal accuracy about the rules and procedures.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Investigate damage cause
desc: Studying the causes of damage, which could be environmental, physical, social, etc. at country level in order to institute better policies and regulations.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Amend or create policy
desc: Crafting a new framework of policies and procedures for deploying remediation efforts, or change existing policies and procedures. Adapt the policy structure to the context of the apposite national and international regulatory frameworks.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Manage business resiliency
desc: Including the processes required to rapidly adapt and respond to any internal or external opportunity, demand, disruption, or threat. Develop a more dynamic, strategic, and integrated approach to managing compliance obligations.
notes: Business continuity and DR - tested annually for both internal and client scope.
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Develop the business resilience strategy
desc: Creating a strategy for rapidly adapting to disturbances. Maintain continuous business processes and protecting employees, assets, and overall brand equity. This is inclusive of all forms of new and evolving technology such as artificial intelligence (AI).
notes: Business continuity and DR - tested annually for both internal and client scope.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Perform continuous business operations planning
desc: Developing plans to ensure continuous business operations.
notes: Business continuity and DR - tested annually for both internal and client scope.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Conduct business impact analysis and set recovery tiers
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: Department leaders' BIA sets each system's recovery tier and each critical function's maximum tolerable downtime and alternate processing; reviewed at least annually.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Test continuous business operations
desc: Assessing ongoing activities within the organization that are not intended to stop except for in an emergency.
notes: Business continuity and DR - tested annually for both internal and client scope.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Run the continuity test calendar
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: Annual tabletop, emergency access test, unannounced communication tree test (90% acknowledge within two hours) and runbook walkthrough for each critical system; results and corrective actions retained.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Maintain continuous business operations
desc: Evaluating business operations. Determine which activities generate revenues, perform best, and provide good returns.
notes: Business continuity and DR - tested annually for both internal and client scope.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Declare a disaster and activate the response team
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: Assess a reported event within 30 minutes, declare against defined criteria, notify all employees within one hour and affected clients within four hours, with external statements approved by the Executive Sponsor.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Account for personnel after a facility or regional event
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: HR runs a personnel accountability check within four hours of a facility or regional event such as a hurricane.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Hold post-event reviews
pol: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
desc: Formal review within ten business days of stand-down, with corrective actions owned, dated and tracked to closure.

cat: Manage Enterprise Risk, Compliance, Remediation, and Resiliency
name: Share knowledge of specific risks across other parts of the organization
desc: Sharing information about risks and resilience strategies of business operations across the organization so that prospective risks can be avoided.
notes: Business continuity and DR - tested annually for both internal and client scope.

name: Manage External Relationships
desc: Fostering external relationships with stakeholders of the entity, including investors, government and industry, the board of directors, and the general public. This is not related to customer management.

name: Build investor relationships
desc: Creating a strategic management responsibility for integrating finance, communication, marketing, and securities law compliance. Allow the most effective two-way communication among the organization, the financial community, and other constituencies. Enlist the investor relations function to provide market intelligence to corporate management.
notes: Lender and bank relationships.

name: Plan, build, and manage lender relations
desc: Building and managing relations with bankers or lenders through strong products/services strategies that bankers would want to invest in. Foster a receptive environment for low rates of interest, easy access to loans, etc.
notes: Lender and bank relationships.

name: Plan, build, and manage analyst relations
desc: Creating and maintaining long-term relations with analysts. Involve analysts in strategy and product decisions in order to elicit valuable information.
notes: Not publicly traded.

name: Communicate with shareholders
desc: Practicing regular, transparent communication with shareholders through annual shareholders' meetings, quarterly earnings calls, shareholders letters, one-on-one emails or calls, etc.
notes: Lender and bank relationships.

name: Manage government and industry relationships
desc: Creating and maintaining relationships with government and industry representatives.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Manage government relations
desc: Persuading public and government policy at the local, regional, national, and global level (subject to government regulations).
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Assess relationships
desc: Ascertaining how the business entity relates to all levels of government. Identify areas that needs further growth and resources to foster those relationships.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Appoint responsible executives
desc: Assigning executive level resources to manage, grow, and drive relationships with government bodies.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Monitor relationships
desc: Analyzing current relationships with government bodies and entities.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Receive input from internal advisors
desc: Garnering internal advice from an informal group in order to successfully maintain and advance relationships.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Receive input from external advisors
desc: Garnering third party advice from an informal group in order to successfully maintain and advance relationships.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Liaise with authorities
desc: Meeting with government heads and representatives.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Manage relations with quasi-government bodies
desc: Managing relations with quasi-governmental organizations, corporations, businesses, or any other agency that is treated by national laws and principles to be under the supervision of the government but also distinct and self-directed from the government.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Establish relationships with agencies
desc: Engaging government, regulatory, or industry agencies to establish relationships. Analyze steps and requirements necessary for inclusion, if needed.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Respond to audit inquiries
desc: Cooperating with auditors regarding potential or ongoing inquiries.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Maintain documentation of contacts
desc: Keeping a repository of documents that contain information about the network of partners, prospects and customers. Keep records up-to-date with routine reviews and modify as needed.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Plan and manage meetings
desc: Ensuring regular interaction between business entity and quasi-government bodies in order to maintain established relationships. Collect and record meeting data for further analysis and use.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Manage relations with trade or industry groups
desc: Managing relations with organizations established and financed by businesses that operate in a specific industry. Participate in public relations actions such as lobbying and publishing, advertising, education, and political donations.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Evaluate the requirements for strategic relationships
desc: Determining the requirements to enter in to an agreement with trade or industry agencies. Discover what activities or processes can be conducted to provide the best mutual outcome.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Monitor the success of the partnerships
desc: Analyzing current relationships with trade and industry groups. Ensure that the partnership in successful and make modifications where needed.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Extend or change the relationships
desc: Providing additional information or inclusion for third party trade or industry entities; or changing existing parameters to modify the current relationship. Communicate and execute changes.
notes: Partner ecosystems (Microsoft, Cisco) and trade associations.

name: Manage lobby activities
desc: Managing lobbying activities to affect government policies.

name: Manage relations with board of directors
desc: Maintaining relations with representatives of the stockholders. Establish corporate management-related policies and to make decisions on major company issues. Implement practices designed to engender communication, trust, and cooperation.
notes: Board and ownership reporting - ties to the valuation and growth plan.

name: Report financial results
desc: Reporting financial results to management, and releasing results to the public. Report financial statements, including the income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows.
notes: Board and ownership reporting - ties to the valuation and growth plan.

name: Report audit findings
desc: Reporting audit findings to management. Practice an internal audit with criteria for confirming a problem, a description of the situation, and the root cause of the problem. Make recommendations that resolve the issue.
notes: Board and ownership reporting - ties to the valuation and growth plan.

name: Manage legal and ethical issues
desc: Managing legal practices to abide by the law, as well as ethical practices.

name: Create ethics policies
desc: Creating a code of ethics that communicate the organization's philosophy to employees, vendors, customers, clients, and the public.

name: Manage corporate governance policies
desc: Administering the system of rules, practices, and processes through which a company is directed and controlled. Balance stakeholder interests including shareholders, management, customers, suppliers, financiers, government, and the community. Outline a strategy for achieving organizational goals, from action plans and internal controls to performance measurement and corporate disclosure.

name: Develop and perform preventive law programs
desc: Creating and applying programs and activities. Encourage the adherence preventive laws, such as environmental law, sex discrimination, computer law, estate planning, corporate compliance, business planning, and property transactions.

name: Ensure compliance
desc: Ensuring the organization's compliance position. Validate compliance with different statutes, regulatory directions, and legal principles (using Establish compliance framework and policies [17468]). Coordinate with compliance and risk management personnel.

name: Plan and initiate compliance program
desc: Employing an internal system or process to identify and reduce the risk of breaching the Competition and Consumer Act 2010. Remedy any breach. Create a culture of compliance. Design compliance programs.

name: Execute compliance program
desc: Implementing the established compliance program in order to meet the government laws and regulations. Create a compliance team that scrutinizes the rules set out by government bodies such as the Securities and Exchange Commission.

name: Manage outside counsel
desc: Managing professionals, sought externally for assistance over legal and ethical concerns. Administer and oversee assistance from subject matter experts and professionals for sourcing expert opinion and counseling over legal and ethical matters.

name: Assess problem and determine work requirements
desc: Examining the problems and deciding the action requirements for engaging outside counsel. This process element calls upon the organization to internally analyze the issues for which assistance from external counsel is needed. Additionally, the organization needs to break-down the issue, identifying the tasks and exercises where outside counsel can help.

name: Engage/Retain outside counsel if necessary
desc: Recruiting the assistance of outside counsel for any legal and/or ethical concerns. Engage and/or retain any external counsel sought from subject matter experts and professionals.

name: Receive strategy/budget
desc: Making a financial plan. This strategy sets out, using figures, an organization's expected future results. Enlist the finance function to support work generated by other business functions in order to build and secure their support for the budget.

name: Receive work product and manage/monitor case and work performed
desc: Receiving deliverables from outside counsel, and monitoring the efforts committed by them. Track the progress of, collect, and validate the required work product from the subject matter experts and professionals engaged as external counsel. Verify the amount of effort dedicated by these counsels to the issue at hand, in order to confirm their fees.

name: Process payment for legal services
desc: Making payments to legal advisers for their services. Payments include addressing issues or suits by customers, suppliers, competitors, bankers, government agencies, etc.

name: Track legal activity/performance
desc: Keeping track of the legal activities and performance of the organization.

name: Protect intellectual property
desc: Safeguarding the intellectual property of the organization. This process requires the organization to protect a wide variety of intellectual property created by it. This includes leveraging artificial intelligence(AI) to identify potential infringement of intellectual property and making sure employees are adhering to company policies around use of artificial intelligence(AI). It involves creating and managing non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), following up on current developments in the areas where the organization holds patents, tracking the use of the organization's copyrighted material, creating and upholding licensing terms, and administering policies for safeguarding intellectual property.

name: Manage copyrights, patents, and trademarks
desc: Managing the patents and copyrights already held or sought by the organization. Administer and oversee applying for, securing, and maintaining intellectual property rights in the form of patents and copyrights. Submit applications for such rights. Handle associated legal issues. Draft and communicate proper attributions. Collect royalties. Monitor any misuse of the intellectual property rights.

name: Maintain intellectual property rights and restrictions
desc: Managing the upkeep of intellectual property rights by creating and managing a framework of rules, policies, procedures, and restrictions. Outline a clear policy for any possible scenario of their use by any external agent.

name: Administer licensing terms
desc: Administering and overseeing the terms and policies associated with licensing the organization's intellectual property. Create and manage the policies and terms governing the possible granting of a license to any external agent. Demarcate a clear framework that governs the licensing of any patents or copyrights held by the organization.

name: Administer options
desc: Managing options regarding licensing agreements. Follow favorable terms and conditions.

name: Resolve disputes and litigations
desc: Resolving disputes or civil lawsuits internally or externally.

name: Provide legal advice/counseling
desc: Providing legal advice concerning the substance or procedure of a law in relation to a particular situation.

name: Negotiate and document agreements/contracts
desc: Negotiating terms to reach a final draft of a contract that is acceptable to all parties.
notes: MSAs, SOWs, subcontracts and NDAs.

name: Manage public relations program
desc: Managing a public relations programs through business and communications skills.

name: Manage community relations
desc: Developing and administering community relations. Establish business connections with the people constituting the environment the organization operates in and draws resources from in order to foster mutual understanding, trust, and support. Create programs that promote the organization's image in a positive and community-oriented way.

name: Manage media relations
desc: Developing and managing relations with media. Develop connections with journalists to solicit critical, third-party endorsements for a product, issue, service, or organization.

name: Promote political stability
desc: Promoting political security and stability in the regions where the organization conducts business. Encourage political stability in the regions where the organization operates. Support civic programs, citizen engagement, connection platforms, etc.

name: Create press releases
desc: Developing press releases to communicate developments and generate interest in the organization.

name: Issue press releases
desc: Issuing press releases to carefully selected media in distribution channels such as the web, newspapers, and social media.

name: Develop and Manage Business Capabilities
desc: Performing activities by an organization that are fundamental to the successful operation of the organization, even across functions in a business. Capabilities defined in the PCF include business process management; portfolio, program, and project management; quality management; change management; benchmarking; environmental health and safety management; and knowledge management.

name: Manage business processes
desc: Establishing and administering governance for management of the processes. Outline and manage the frameworks for management of the processes. Define the business processes. Administer the performance of the processes. Enhance the business processes.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Establish and maintain process management governance
desc: Defining and managing the organization's approach to governing business process management. Establish and manage tools to support the governance process. Assign ownership for all business processes. Perform activities to administer the governing process.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Define and manage governance approach
desc: Outlining and managing the methodology for administering business process management (BPM). Define the method for setting standards and priorities for BPM efforts. Identify BPM governance leaders. Define BPM project participants' roles.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Establish and maintain process tools and templates
desc: Instituting, organizing, and maintaining the upkeep of the techniques used for business process management (BPM). Create and maintain templates of BPM tools that can be readily implemented, including process engine, business analytics, content management, and collaboration tools.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Assign and support process ownership
desc: Assigning resources (employees) ownership of tasks. These include the responsibility of identifying, analyzing, and improving business processes in order to meet the goals and objectives such as increasing profits and performance, reducing costs, and accelerating schedules.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Perform process governance activities
desc: Implementing and executing activities for governing business processes. Execute activities that encourage participation, accountability, transparency, responsiveness, equity and inclusiveness, etc. within the business processes.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Define and manage process frameworks
desc: Determining and organizing the structural composition of business processes. Design, establish, and administer the framework. Identify any cross-functional processes that are mandatory for achieving business excellence.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Establish and maintain process framework
desc: Defining and managing the framework that outlines the required business processes of the organization, key elements, and how they should interact. Institute strategy infrastructure and product, operations, and enterprise management.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Identify cross-functional processes
desc: Recognizing the different functional areas working on the same project or goal.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Define processes
desc: Outlining and establishing the business processes of the organization. Scope, analyze, map, and publish processes for the employees who may require it.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Scope processes
desc: Defining the extent and limits of business processes. Define the range and diversity of all the set of activities and tasks that, once completed, will accomplish an organizational goal.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Analyze processes
desc: Assessing and examining the set of activities and tasks that, once completed, will accomplish an organizational goal. Create a business process model that captures how a business process works and how individuals from different groups work together to achieve a business goal.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Identify published best practices
desc: Realizing those practices and procedures that are the most effective to the success of the business and making that information available.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Identify and denote process control points
desc: Establishment of a "checkpoint" in a process that prevent the process from continuing unless all requirements are satisfied.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Model and document processes
desc: Defining what a business entity does, who is responsible, to what standard a business process should be completed, and how the success of a business process can be determined. Identify processes, gather information gathering, interview participants, map processes, and perform analysis.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Publish processes
desc: Disclosing the information available on business processes. Ensure the availability of the information regarding the business processes to all process team members, business stakeholders, and process owners. Use BPM software, as well as business process diagrams and documents that help depict the required information.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Manage process performance
desc: Evaluating and handling the performance of business processes. Provide training to process owners. Support the execution of business processes. Measure and report the performance of the business processes.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Provide process training
desc: Providing training for the employees and process owners that administer the business processes. Design internal training programs or source third party agencies to provide the skills and training necessary.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Support process execution
desc: Assisting and executing the business processes. Use business process execution language (BEPL), which is a standard, executable language for specifying actions within the business processes with the use of web services.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Measure and report process performance
desc: Defining and using performance indicators to consider the financial perspective, customer perspective, internal process perspective, and learning perspective of the organization.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Identify additional metrics as required
desc: Determining the need for additional performance indicators that would be necessary to successfully achieve the business goal.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Improve processes
desc: Identifying, selecting, and managing improvements. Based on the type and scope of the improvement, determination of the appropriate improvement methodology (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, etc.) should guide the effort. This includes continuous improvement, process redesign, process reengineering, and application of the organizations approaches for Manage projects.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Identify and select improvement opportunities
desc: Helping a process owner to identify, analyze, and improve existing business processes within an organization to meet new goals and objectives.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Select process improvement methodology
desc: Assessing and choosing methodologies to identify, analyze, and improve existing processes within an organization to meet new goals and objective. Assess the various methodologies available such as process mapping, statistical process control, and simulation. Choose the most appropriate and effective methodology.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Manage improvement projects
desc: Developing and implementing a systematic approach to help the organization optimize its underlying processes in order to achieve more efficient results. Systematically gather information to clarify issues or problems. Intervene for improvements. Restructure training programs as appropriate to increase effectiveness.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Perform continuous improvement activities
desc: Persistently implementing activities for improving business processes.
notes: This project. Process governance, documentation and the EOS Process component.

name: Manage portfolio, program, and project
desc: Managing investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands, along with the related projects that together constitute a program.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Manage portfolio
desc: Managing the business portfolio of the organization, including investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands. Establish a portfolio strategy. Define portfolio governance. Monitor and control the portfolio.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Establish portfolio strategy
desc: Instituting the strategy for managing business portfolio. Create a systematic plan that defines the strategy for managing investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Define portfolio governance
desc: Outlining the administration of business portfolio of the organization. Create and manage the rules and regulations regarding the business processes in order to identify, select, prioritize, and monitor portfolio components. Include a set of metrics to indicate the health and progress of the portfolio in the most vital area.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Monitor and control portfolio
desc: Overseeing and administering the business portfolio of the organization. Monitor all activities related to investments, holdings, products, businesses, and brands by effectively monitoring and supervising these activities.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Manage programs
desc: Establishing, implementing, and managing business programs. Successfully handle related projects that together constitute a program. Establish the program structure and approach. Coordinate with stakeholders and partners. Execute the program. Assess and report the performance of the program. Coordinate and prioritize resources across projects. Manage links between the projects and the overall costs and risks of the program.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Establish program structure and approach
desc: Constructing and instituting the framework and approach to manage business programs. Monitor key factors such as governance, alignment with the overall business vision, assurance, and management.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Manage program stakeholders and partners
desc: Managing relationships with stakeholders and partners of the business programs.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Manage program execution
desc: Administering and implementing business programs. Implement and execute programs with the intention of improving an organization's performance. Execute all the individual projects of the program to ensure the desired success.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Review and report program performance
desc: Evaluating and documenting the performance of business programs. Evaluate the performance of the programs. Create reports on the basis of the analysis. Use performance indicators and metrics such as desired/achieved goals, completion dates, issues and defects, and cost effectiveness.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Manage projects
desc: Establishing the scope of the projects. Create plans for implementing the projects. Initiate projects. Review and report project performance to management. Close projects.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Establish project scope
desc: Establishing the horizons of business projects. Identify the objectives of the program, along with the resource requirements. Assess the readiness for the project management approach. Identify methodologies for project management. Obtain funding. Develop performance measures and indicators.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Identify project requirements and objectives
desc: Recognizing and defining what the project is ultimately supposed to do. Specify the capabilities, features, or attributes of the project's deliverables, as well as any kind of formal documentation.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Identify project resource requirements
desc: Identifying the prerequisites of business projects. Identify the people with appropriate and applicable skills and competencies. Locate resources such as capital, facilities, equipment, material, and information required to accomplish the objectives of a specific project.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Assess culture and readiness for project management approach
desc: Evaluating the culture and readiness of the organizational environment is order to implement the project management approach.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Create business case
desc: Creating a document that includes the current situation, proposed solution, financial analysis, conclusion, etc. Convince a decision maker and investors to approve the project. Obtain funding.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Develop project measures and indicators
desc: Developing procedures and indictors to assess performance of business projects. Design and develop metrics and indicators--such as cost, schedule, resources, risk, and quality--that exhibit the performance of the business projects.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Prioritize and select projects for the portfolio
desc: Stack ranking of projects in the portfolio based upon preestablished criteria.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Identify appropriate project management methodologies
desc: Identifying and implementing the techniques and procedures for managing business projects. Identify the most appropriate models, which are to be employed by the project managers for the purpose of designing, planning, implementing, and achieving project objectives. Examine and assess various project management methodologies such as adaptive project framework, agile development, crystal methods, and feature-driven development.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Develop project plans
desc: Defining the resources and their roles. Identify IT requirements. Create plans for effective training and communication. Design reward approaches. Plan the launch of project. Deploy the project.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Define roles and resources
desc: Outlining the resources and their roles in the business projects.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Acquire/secure project resources
desc: Procuring the necessary resources outlined in Define roles and resources [11123]
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Identify specific IT requirements
desc: Determining the IT requirements for specific business projects. Identify the requirements of computers and telecommunications equipment to store, retrieve, transmit, and manipulate data related to the project. Consider factors such as functional requirements, design requirements, project phases, and project schedule.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Create training and communication plans
desc: Designing a plan for equipping the project team with the necessary skills and abilities to fulfill their roles and responsibilities in the project effectively and efficiently. Offer formal training, mentoring, or coaching. Initiate informal conversations. Communicate messages during the project.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Design recognition and reward approaches
desc: Creating a plan for recognizing and rewarding extraordinary performances within the business projects. Use incentives, bonuses, and certificates for recognition and rewarding purposes.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Design and plan launch of project
desc: Creating a plan specifying when to initiate the project, and introducing it to the target audience. Clearly define the project team, objectives, timelines, and milestone.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Deploy the project
desc: Putting the project into position by effectively bringing it into action.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Execute projects
desc: Implementing the business projects of the organization. Evaluate the impact of project management. Record and report the status of the project. Manage the project scope. Promote and sustain activities and involvement. Realign and revamp the project management strategy and approach.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Evaluate impact of project management (strategy and projects) on measures and outcomes
desc: Assessing the impact of business project management on the measures and outcomes of the projects. Gauge non-financial measures, frequency of measurement, action plan, etc.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Report the status of project
desc: Recording and documenting the current status and position of the project. Record and report items such as completed tasks, incomplete tasks, planned tasks, and problems faced.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Manage project scope
desc: Determining and documenting a list of specific project goals, deliverables, tasks, costs, and deadlines. Use the scope statement to explain the boundaries of the project. Assign responsibilities for team members. Set up procedures for verifying and approving the completed tasks.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Promote and sustain activity and involvement
desc: Encouraging and sustaining the activities and involvement while executing projects. Promote the execution activities of the projects. Encourage employee involvement in project implementation.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Conduct Project Reviews with Program Managers and other stakeholders
desc: Hold post project reviews, lessons learned, or After Action Reviews (AARs) at the end of each project to understand what could be improved during future projects.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Realign and refresh project management strategy and approaches
desc: Reorganizing and stimulating the approach and strategy for managing business projects. Make improvements based on the project scope and on findings from Evaluate the impact of project management (strategy and projects) on measures and outcomes [11131].
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Adjust project plan as needed
desc: Changes to project plans based upon internal and or external influences on the project.  This would include the update to the project plan file, as well as the communication to the team.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Review and report project performance
desc: Measuring the performance of a business project against key performance indicators including the project scope, schedule, quality, cost, and risk criteria. Identify any deviations from the plan. Assess the impact of these deviations on the project, as well as on the overall program. Report results to key stakeholders.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Close projects
desc: Settling each contract. Close each contract applicable to the project or project phase. Finalize all activities across all of the process groups in order to formally close the project or a project phase.
notes: PS portfolio, program and project management; drives project profitability.

name: Manage enterprise quality
desc: Managing organizational attributes that are closely associated with the quality of output. Determine the quality requirements. Evaluate the correspondence between the quality performance and requirements. Manage non-conformance activities. Ensure implementation and maintenance of the enterprise quality management system.

name: Establish quality requirements
desc: Determining essential activities, processes, and attributes for securing enterprise quality. Outline critical characteristics for quality. Outline activities encouraging the preservation of quality. Create quality controls. Confirm capabilities in accordance with quality requirements. Finalize the plan for quality maintenance.

name: Define critical-to-quality characteristics
desc: Outlining characteristics crucial for managing enterprise quality. Translate broad customer needs into specific, actionable, measurable performance requirements. Define the key measurable characteristics of key products and processes.

name: Define preventive quality activities
desc: Identifying gaps in customer requirements and determining whether the gap will be mitigated through preventive Quality activities or deemed as acceptable risk. The goal of any preventive quality activities is to create provisions to prevent, control, or reduce the risk of not meeting the CtQCs. In addition, any standard methodology that will be used to design or conduct preventive Quality activities are defined and documented.

name: Develop quality controls
desc: Developing controls for managing the quality of enterprise. Define the process steps for quality controls and the sampling plan. Identify the tools and methods to measure quality. Define the competencies required.

name: Define process steps for controls (or integration points)
desc: Establishing the steps for developing quality controls. Conduct Alpha testing. Have the product team conduct rework. Send the product/service for Beta testing, and carry on rework as needed.

name: Define sampling plan
desc: Establishing a detailed summary including measures, on which material, in what manner, and by whom. Identify the parameters to be measured, the range of possible values, and the required resolution. Provide a sampling scheme that details how and when samples will be taken. Select sample sizes. Assign roles and responsibilities.

name: Identify measurement methods
desc: Using tools to measure quality. Use tools such as quality improvement oversight system tool, performance measurement tools, consumer information models/guides, and validation tools to effectively determine the quality levels.

name: Define required competencies
desc: Defining the competencies required for developing quality controls. Define the required competencies including compliance management, audit management, and document control and document management.

name: Prove capability to assess compliance with requirements
desc: Demonstrating the ability and capability to confirm and fulfill the quality requirements in front of customers, managers, employees, board members, associations, regulatory bodies, and creditors. Leverage tools and techniques such as process behavior or control charts, statistical process control, measurement system analysis, gage calibration management, and process capability analysis.

name: Finalize quality plan
desc: Establishing how the critical-to-quality characteristics will be achieved, controlled, ensured, and managed throughout the lifecycle of a product/service. Address quality requirements and critical-to-quality characteristics. Conduct a preventive quality assessment. Describe how to verify the product/service, verification criteria, and response to nonconformance. Keep records to demonstrate conformity.

name: Evaluate performance to requirements
desc: Analyzing if the performance of the quality plan has achieved the estimated and desired requirements. Conduct tests against the quality plan. Assess the results of these tests.

name: Test against quality plan
desc: Examining the quality of organizational processes. Conduct tests. Collect information and data. Record the results of these tests. Determine the dispositions of the test results.

name: Conduct test and collect data
desc: Evaluating quality performance through periodic or episodic testing against the established standards for quality characteristics. For periodic testing, design a schedule with sufficient time to make any required adjustments to the process or system to maintain the desired level of quality. For episodic testing, conduct a test whenever a known non-conformance or fault occurs, which results in outputs or outcomes known to be unsatisfactory to performance requirements.

name: Record result(s)
desc: Maintaining and recording the results of Test against the quality plan [17483] electronically and in standard formats. Assign ownership to a designated function or role.

name: Determine disposition of result(s)
desc: Deciding whether to take any additional actions based on the results of quality tests. Initiate a quarantine disposition and relocated inventory, scrap workflow item and scrap transaction, rework operation, net-able and nonnet-able items, and the activity list.

name: Assess results of tests
desc: Assessing the significance of the sample. Summarize the results of the test. Recommend improvement actions. Decide what steps to take next.

name: Assess sample significance
desc: Assessing the significance of the sample chosen for the test in order to determine whether or not the sample is representative of the larger output or outcome. Determine if the sample meets or does not meet the requirements. Identify the conditions for acceptance, rejection, remediation, and prevention.

name: Summarize result(s)
desc: Outlining the major facts and figures of the quality test results in order to provide insights and information. Use charts, tables, statistical test results, and written findings and conclusions in a summary of results.

name: Recommend actions
desc: Recommending measures for improvement. Assess the summarized results to identify areas which can be improved. Suggest actions to management for improving the quality plan basis on the results of the tests.

name: Decide next steps
desc: Selecting the subsequent actions that the organization can adopt for improving the enterprise quality. Select measures and recommended actions for managing the enterprise quality.

name: Manage non-conformance
desc: Handling any nonconformance activities or events. Assess the potential impact of the nonconformity. Decide the immediate actions to take. Identify the root causes. Take corrective or preventive action. Ensure future conformance.

name: Assess potential impact
desc: Analyzing any nonconformance events. Determine the need for corrective and/or preventative action(s). Leverage root-cause analysis, risk exposure, and other evaluations to properly review and approve/reject subsequent actions.

name: Determine immediate action(s)
desc: Initiating immediate corrective, preventative, or no action based upon the impact and likelihood of reoccurrence. Consider cost/benefit, risk exposure, timing, the assignment of responsibility, and other pertinent factors .

name: Identify root cause(s)
desc: Recognizing the reasons that have triggered the nonconformance events or activities. Perform a root-cause analysis through documentary evidence and interviews. Involve the appropriate individuals. Leverage cause analysis and risk assessment.

name: Take corrective or preventative action
desc: Pursuing corrective and preventative activities to eliminate the cause of a detected nonconformity. Define the nonconformity. Communicate and assign responsibility. Identify the appropriate corrective and preventive action. Implement and monitor for reoccurrence.

name: Close non-conformance
desc: Closing nonconformance. Perform all the final processes related to the nonconformance, including documenting root causes. Document corrective and preventive actions.

name: Implement and maintain the enterprise quality management system (EQMS)
desc: Establishing and administering the software that manages content and business processes for quality and compliance across the value chain. Define the quality strategy. Plan and deploy the EQMS scope, targets, and goals. Identify core process controls and metric. Develop EQMS governance. Assess the performance of EQMS. Encourage improvements in EQMS.

name: Define the quality strategy
desc: Outlining the strategy for managing enterprise quality. Define and formalize quality techniques and standards. Assign responsibilities for achieving the required quality levels. Standardize the quality maintenance procedure, tools and techniques, recording and reporting, the timing of quality maintenance activities, and the roles and responsibilities for the quality management team.

name: Plan and deploy the EQMS scope, targets, and goals
desc: Establishing and effectively deploying the scope, targets, and goals of EQMS. Define the role of EQMS through nonconformance/corrective and preventive action, compliance/audit management, risk management, failure mode and effects analysis, and statistical process control. Implement EQMS into operational activities. Define the goals and objectives that are to be achieved by the EQMS.

name: Identify core EQMS processes, controls, and metrics
desc: Recognizing and implementing the processes, controls, and metrics for maintenance of EQMS. Define the role of EQMS in failure mode and effects analysis, complaint handling, and advanced product quality planning. Establish the role of EQMS in evaluating metrics such as cost of quality, overall equipment effectiveness, on-time and complete shipments, percentage of products in compliance, and new product introductions.

name: Develop and document EQMS policies, procedures, standards, and measures
desc: Setting the process limits. Gather required information. Align with other documents and processes. Define the document structure.

name: Assess the EQMS performance
desc: Benchmarking current performance in quality metrics that span across the value chain. Identify gaps in performance as compared to industry peers. Identify and implement complementary EQMS capabilities. Enable a continuous improvement environment.

name: Create environment and capability for EQMS improvement(s)
desc: Rewarding excellence in quality. Create and maintain quality partnerships. Maintain talent capabilities and competencies. Incorporate EQMS messaging into communication channels. Transfer proven EQMS methods. Consider factors such as EQMS reviews and gap assessments and the alignment and compatibility of business processes and quality. Adopt Lean principles.

name: Reward quality excellence
desc: Provisioning rewards for achieving quality excellence. Provide monetary and nonmonetary rewards such as compensation, vacations, gift cards, and reimbursements to employees in in recognition of their services, efforts, and achievements in quality excellence.

name: Create and maintain quality partnerships
desc: Establishing and maintaining partnerships with third-party sources to achieve quality excellence. Source and evaluate third-party sources both public and private to ensure that the most effective and efficient partnerships are formed.

name: Maintain talent capabilities and competencies
desc: Maintaining a common denominator for the competency level within the organization's talent circle. Conduct training sessions, skill development activities, and quality excellence activities to ensure that the resources of the organization are competent enough and have the capabilities to achieve the required level of quality.

name: Incorporate EQMS messaging into communication channels
desc: Assimilating all the communication related to the EQMS into the organization's already established communication channels.

name: Assure independent EQMS management access to appropriate authority in the organization
desc: Ensuring EQMS access to the person in charge of the quality management process. Establish who has the authority to manage the EQMS. Ensure access of EQMS to only the person(s) in authority.

name: Transfer proven EQMS methods
desc: Recording and transferring the best practices and proven methods associated with enterprise quality management systems (EQMS) that can be leveraged in improving the organization's framework. Record proven methodologies and approaches with the objective of communicating them for upgrading, refining, and enhancing the organization's systems.

name: Manage change
desc: Planning, designing, and implementing the change. Ensure improvement in the change process.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Plan for change
desc: Evaluating impact and planning change activities. Spanning the lifecycle of change from initial concept, to designing, implementing, and sustaining the change, change planning identifies the activities to enage and enable the stakeholders and all impacted by the change. Change plans should address the interplay between people, process, technology, and knowledge to guide the transition, or tranformation, from current state to the future state.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Determine stakeholders
desc: Identifying and communicating with shareholders affected by the change. Consider internal and external stakeholders that will be affected by the change. Determine the amount of influence the change will have on them. Ensure the involvement of these stakeholders in the change process by effectively communicating with them.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Assess readiness for change
desc: Determining the level of preparedness of the conditions, attitudes, and resources at all levels in the organization needed for change to happen successfully. Define scope of the proposed change. Select the tools for a change readiness assessment.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Identify change champion(s)
desc: Identifying people exhibit an extraordinary interest in the adoption, implementation, and success of the change. Engage champions in each division or team. Define the roles and responsibilities for the change champions. Determine criteria for selecting change champions. Provide training sessions to champions. Reward and recognize champions.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Form design team
desc: Preparing a design team for implementing change throughout the organization.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Define scope
desc: Defining the extent of the area or subject matter that the change process deals with or to which it is relevant. Establish a set of tools, processes, skills, and principles for managing the people side of change to achieve the required outcomes of the change process.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Understand current state
desc: Using graphical and statistical tools such as pareto diagrams, process flow diagrams, cause-and-effect diagrams, check sheets, histograms, run charts, and scatter diagrams.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Define future state
desc: Determining the state or position that the organization wants to be in after the implementation of the change. Gather necessary information about the processes, structures, and cultures. Define resource requirements.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Conduct organizational risk analysis
desc: Looking beyond the immediate consequences of the threat to a critical asset and placing it in the context of what is important to the organization. Identify the impact of threats to critical assets. Create risk evaluation criteria. Evaluate the impact of threats to critical assets. Incorporate probability into the risk analysis.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Assess cultural context
desc: Evaluating the culture within the organization. Adopt a quantitative, multidimensional measurement approach of an organization's culture and the aspirations for it. Diagnose cultural activities, enhance leadership sections. Integrate cultures.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Identify impacted groups
desc: Recognizing the impact of threats to critical assets. Determine what groups are impacted by this impact.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Determine degree/extent of impact
desc: Evaluating the impact of threats to critical assets. Determine what assets will be impacted by the change.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Establish accountability for change management
desc: Identifying and assigning the people accountable for effective change management. Hold managers accountable for ensuring change happens systematically and rigorously. Ensure that certain behaviors are rewarded or reprimanded accordingly.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Identify barriers to change
desc: Recognizing the circumstances or obstacles that keep the organization from progressing. Identify who and what are the resources resisting change. Identify integration failures, threats by competitive forces, and complexity failures.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Determine change enablers
desc: Identifying the person(s) or thing(s)responsible for making the change possible. Consider factors such as interdependence of efforts, reward to the integrators, sharing of power and responsibility, and employee understanding of why change is essential.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Identify resources and develop measures
desc: Recognizing the resource requirements, and developing measures for change. Identify the financial, material, human, and informational resources needed to successfully implement the change. Develop programs, campaigns, etc. for establishing the change within the organization.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Design the change
desc: Developing plans for change management, training, communication, and rewards/incentives. Establish metrics for measuring the change adoption. Clarify new roles for employees. Identify budgets.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Assess connection to other initiatives
desc: Correlating the change initiative with the other initiatives. Create an alignment between the goals and objectives of the change process and that of the other initiatives.
notes: Change management for the EOS transition and system migrations.

name: Develop change management plans
desc: Creating a detailed structure summary for the purposes of managing the change. Demonstrate the reasons for the change. Define the type and scope of change. Form a change management team. Create a communication plan.
